chapters.title: Chapter 1051 - 523: Seeing Through the Essence, Knowing Past and Future_3
paragraphs: The Aurora True God exclaimed in shock, "This is a method created by Yue Heng himself, I never expected him to master it to such a high degree!"
Beside him, the True God of Crystal was desperately trying to break free from the Broken Moon state, scoffing.
"To think he would dare try to control so many True Gods; the backlash from the rules alone is enough to make him perish."
"Everyone, with me, let’s break through his seal!"
Voom!
All True Gods began to struggle fiercely.
Meanwhile, the full moon began to rapidly collapse.
Yue Heng trembled all over, indeed, as the True God of Crystal had said, he suffered from severe backlash from the rules.
Blood oozed from the corner of his mouth.
At that moment, Yue Heng resolutely detonated the bright moon.
Crack!
Boom!
The bright moon exploded, directly forcing all the True Gods to retreat explosively!
Before they could react.
Yue Heng charged at the group of True Gods, then suddenly self-destructed.
Voom!
The terrifying energy waves spread one after another, forcing the True Gods on the field to retreat continuously.
In the energy vortex, the shouting of numerous True Gods emerged.
"Damn it! These maniacs from the Supreme Hall!"
"Block them! Block them for me!"
This time, the energy impact from Yue Heng’s self-destruction was overwhelmingly terrifying.
In the void, suddenly three Trees of Rules appeared.
Then, three beams of light quickly drilled into the Trees of Rules.
This wave of self-destruction by Yue Heng actually took away three True Gods directly.
Ten seconds remain.
Celestial Fall and Dragon War exchanged a glance, for they saw the hope of victory!
Meanwhile, Han Xing nervously watched the progress bar before him.
"It’s close! The last one percent, ten seconds remaining, hang in there!"
In the area where Han Xing was located, the Power of Rules grew increasingly fierce, becoming such that even with the power of these True Gods, they couldn’t see what was happening.
And the Power of Rules they possessed was continuously urging the deities to eliminate Han Xing immediately!
The Aurora True God urgently said, "Stop hiding and go interrupt him quickly!"
Voom!
All True Gods no longer concealed their strength, bursting out terrifying auras, rushing towards Celestial Fall and Dragon War!
As for Celestial Fall, naturally, he knew this was the moment they absolutely couldn’t let them come over.
In an instant, he and Dragon War spoke in unison.
"The Self!"
"The Self!
"Merge again!"
At this moment, they actually merged their selves again.
Hundreds of Dragon War and Celestial Fall began to merge, their aura soaring madly!
At the cost of ever-increasing cracks on their bodies.
Already resembling dried clay figures exposed to the sun!
Their sides instantaneously collided!
This was their last wave of confrontation!
"Celestial Fall, get out of my way!!!"
"Spear of Judgment, break for me!"
"Aurora Shining, Annihilation Divine Light!"
All True Gods released their strongest attacks!
At this moment, Han Xing’s progress bar had reached one hundred percent.
In an instant, the entire void was swept by an invisible force.
Time seemed to freeze!
In front of Han Xing appeared a system prompt.
[Successfully condensed special unique Divine Format: Attributeless, would you like to fuse it?]
Was this even a question?
Han Xing had sacrificed so much, all for this moment.
Instantly, Han Xing clicked yes.
In the next moment, that Divine Format entered Han Xing’s body, merging with him.
Han Xing felt as if he entered a peculiar perspective.
The entire world seemed to be in a state of time pause.
Moreover, he could freely control his consciousness, detaching from his body, then entering the void.
With a thought, Han Xing appeared in the battlefield of the True Gods.
In the time pause state, Han Xing could clearly see their ferocious faces, every pore.
Even the rule fluctuations on their bodies could be instinctively perceived.
Han Xing’s gaze settled on Celestial Fall and Dragon War.
At that moment, Han Xing seemed to see through their essence and the layers of illusions.
"Interesting, so this is how Ten Thousand Me is used?"
"Seems like merging oneself from different times and spaces, but in fact, it’s not."
"There is no self from different times and spaces; the so-called fusion of the self is merely stacking the same type of Power of Rules instantly onto oneself."
Han Xing showed an enlightened look, seeing the essence of all things more clearly.
Apart from these, Han Xing also saw the various rule lines connected to each person.
Among them, one line was exceptionally thick.
From this rule line, Han Xing could see the life experiences of these True Gods from youth to adulthood.
He approached the closest Aurora True God and gently plucked the line above its head with his hand.
Then Han Xing saw its life experiences from youth to adulthood.
The Aurora True God started as an ordinary Light-Inviting Bird, living a life of hunger, hunted by predators daily.
However, through a series of encounters, he gradually changed his own bloodline.
Transforming from Light-Inviting Bird to Two-headed Sunbird, soaring to reach the sky, eventually becoming a Middle-tier True God.
Then during a battle with Hunter, he was sealed within the Forbidden Star River.
Strangely, not only did Han Xing see its past.
Through this line, Han Xing even saw its future.
The screen depicted the Aurora True God would slay Celestial Fall and then swallow Han Xing, borrowing generous rewards from the Power of Rules to make a breakthrough to become a High-tier True God.
Becoming the new Emperor level existence in the Silent Star River.
Yet, in reality, this future hadn’t occurred.
Because Han Xing had already broken through successfully.
Han Xing chuckled, "This so-called future, doesn’t seem to be accurate."
And as Han Xing’s words fell, the future on this line changed.
Han Xing saw the Aurora True God face punishment from the rules due to a failed action, fleeing into the void after a battle with Han Xing.
One day in the future, secretly approaching the Holy Spirit Realm, prepared to rush to the Land of the Abandoned Gods.
A decayed and terrifying aura suddenly emerged from the Sea of Light, approaching the Aurora True God at unimaginable speed.
Then, the Aurora True God vanished.
A new True God was reborn, utilizing its body for resurrection!

chapters.title: Chapter 1052 - 524: Changing the Future! Annihilate the Ancient Evil Gods!
paragraphs: Witnessing this scene, Han Xing was instantly stunned!
"Holy shit! What did I just see?"
"The Aurora True God was killed by that old man from the Sea of Light?"
"Holy shit! Holy shit!"
Han Xing exclaimed incessantly, through these images, he seemed to know that the old man from the Sea of Light actually hides extremely terrifying strength.
Even able to seize the body of a middle-tier True God.
At this moment, Han Xing seemed to understand something.
"I see, no wonder that old man told me to find this three-headed bird back then."
"It seems he has long set his sights on the Aurora True God."
"And the Aurora True God originally could break through to Emperor Level by killing me."
"Now, the future has changed, the Aurora True God will be seized by the old man from the Sea of Light at the instant he enters the Holy Spirit Realm."
Han Xing felt increasingly amazed by his ability.
Because he, in a way, saw the future!
And saw some old secrets!
However, just as Han Xing wanted to see more.
A vast power descended, directly pulling his consciousness back into his body.
Time began to flow again.
The ultimate moves of the True Gods have already descended.
And Dragon War and Celestial Fall were being blasted back continuously, seemingly about to be blown up on the spot!
Han Xing’s pupils shrank, instantly wanting Radiance to take him and flee.
Having successfully broken through, why linger here dealing with these True Gods?
It was definitely wise to flee immediately!
And just at this moment, a system notification appeared.
[Detected survivor: Han Xing, has successfully transformed to a Demigod!]
[Breakthrough successful, you have become a special ’???’ life form, all attributes increased by 500%, Divine Power Value increased by 500%, unlocked infinite future abilities.]
[Infinite Domain Skill has been enhanced.]
[Infinite Domain Level 10: Special hidden skill]

[Effect 1: Distance unrestricted, applies 3 layers of Infinite Domain to all friendly units (including Defense Towers, domain structures, pets, servants, etc.), all attributes increased by 300% (including Divine Power Value), and grants self an additional 90% damage reduction effect.]
[Effect 2: Within the Infinite Domain, you possess infinite creation ability, you can simulate once, after opening the domain, record the strongest attack, and cause 300% damage of this attack.]
Seeing this system prompt, Han Xing’s eyes instantly filled with intense shock.
"Holy shit! Three layers of Infinite Domain! And it’s unrestricted distance!"
"That’s freaking outrageous!"
You know, even two pieces of the Sun Crown Stele only increased all attributes by 200% and couldn’t apply to allies.
But Han Xing’s Infinite Domain can not only enhance Defense Towers but also apply to Cheng Jianyong, True God of Radiance, and others.
And this is Han Xing’s most terrifying transformation!
With him around, teammates can exert multiple times their combat strength!
Moreover, there’s no limit on the number of targets!
Han Xing, who originally intended to flee immediately, suddenly had a different idea.
That is, he seemed able to overturn this situation with this skill?
Of course, provided that the Infinite Domain can be applied to Dragon War and Celestial Fall.
After all, strictly speaking, they are not considered his teammates.
Just fellow disciples.
However, Han Xing decided to give it a try anyway.
At this moment.
Han Xing activated the Infinite Domain.
He entered a peculiar state.
As if he could clearly see the connection between everyone on the field and himself.
True God of Radiance, Madeleine, and others’ connections with him were white.
The connections of the three Ancient Gods and the True Gods of the Forbidden Star River were red.
As for the four demons of the Abyss Realm, it was an eerie black.
When Han Xing looked at the connection with Celestial Fall and Dragon War, his eyes suddenly lit up.
Because their lines were also white!
"There’s hope!
This indicates that Han Xing had a high chance of also applying the Infinite Domain to them, strengthening their combat power.
At this moment, Han Xing, who had already successfully broken through, suddenly leaped up.
"I’ve broken through, you guys have no chance now."
Hearing Han Xing’s words, all the True Gods couldn’t help but stop their actions.
When they saw the aura on Han Xing was indeed several times more formidable than before, their pupils shrank instantly.
"Damn it! He really broke through!"
"The Power of Rules has also stopped raging, it seems even the rules can’t restrain this kid anymore."
"Aurora, what do we do now?"
On the field, all the True Gods looked towards the Aurora True God.
He was the most powerful existence on the Forbidden Star River camp.
And the Aurora True God’s six eyes were narrowed.
After pondering for a moment, the Aurora True God’s eyes turned cold, "So what if he broke through?"
"This kid is just a Demigod!"
"Keep attacking, kill Celestial Fall and Dragon War, then eliminate this kid!"
"By then, the Power of Rules will certainly continue rewarding us!"
Upon hearing this, all the True Gods nodded.
Then, they launched a frenzied attack on Celestial Fall and Dragon War again.
"Ugh!"
Celestial Fall kept spitting out Blood of the True God while defending and said with difficulty: "Kid, run fast!"
"You’ve broken through, something the Hunter never achieved."
"As long as you survive, you have infinite possibilities!"
He looked at Dragon War beside him, quickly telepathically said: "Dragon War! I originally thought this kid most likely would fail."
"Turns out he succeeded!"
"Today, we either fall entirely or give him the chance to grow!"
Dragon War also nodded heavily.
In their eyes, a determination to die emerged.

chapters.title: Chapter 1053 - 524: Changing the Future! Blasting Ancient Evil Gods! (Part 2)
paragraphs: If True Gods like them are prepared for a death battle, it will be truly terrifying!
A formidable aura rises again frantically from their bodies.
The Aurora True God exclaimed, "Celestial Fall, Dragon War, are you crazy?"
"You’re overdrawing the power of rules, drawing strength from the Tree of Rules!"
"After this battle, your Tree of Rules will completely collapse, and you might never revive again!"
Upon hearing Aurora True God’s explanation, the other True Gods couldn’t help but feel an indescribable shock.
However, Celestial Fall laughed and said, "I control the rules; I’ll use them however I want!"
"You guys seem to be masters of the rules, but actually, you’re just puppets of the rules!"
"Watch carefully now, this is how you use the power of rules!"
With those words, Celestial Fall’s aura began to grow frantically.
According to Han Xing’s vision of the future, Celestial Fall and Dragon War would fall into utter decline after a burst and be killed by Aurora True God.
Then, Aurora True God would kill Han Xing as well.
Therefore, Han Xing couldn’t let this future unfold.
So, he spoke, "Celestial Fall, Dragon War, don’t rush, I have a way!"
Upon hearing this, the aura of the two middle-tier Demigods paused.
They turned their heads, looking at Han Xing in confusion.
Had it been someone else, they might not have believed at all.
But this kid is the only one they’ve seen break through the limitations of the rules.
Perhaps there really are some miraculous means?
At this moment, Han Xing laughed and said, "Radiance, Madeleine, can you still fight?"
Currently, Radiance and Madeleine, who were severely injured, stood up one after another.
After this period, they had regained a bit of strength.
"Master, I will fight for you to the end."
Madeleine also chuckled and said, "A bunch of freeloaders trying to deal with Master, first step over my dead body~"
Han Xing laughed and said, "No need for you to fight to the death; next, be prepared to counterattack.
In the perplexed gazes of the four,
Han Xing focused his mind, and four groups of energy flooded into everyone’s body through the line connecting them.
Suddenly, Celestial Fall, who was being besieged, widened his eyes.
He felt a surge of power within him, at least three times stronger than before!
In a dual fusion of the self-state, Celestial Fall nearly reached the Emperor Level!
Yet due to certain rule limitations, they could never break that limit.
But now, Han Xing’s Infinite Domain directly bypassed the rules, allowing Celestial Fall to possess Emperor-level combat power!
There is as much a chasm between Emperor-level and below as heaven and earth!
If the Nether Emperor had emerged from the Silent Star River then, Han Xing’s side would already have been defeated and wiped out.
At this moment, countless thoughts flashed through Celestial Fall’s mind.
He quickly understood; this was Han Xing’s described means of counterattack!
Celestial Fall’s three eyes opened wide, shockingly saying, "Well, well, well! Just this hand makes this kid stronger than the Hunter, hahaha!"
At this moment, genuine Emperor-level aura burst from Celestial Fall!
All True Gods on the scene looked at Celestial Fall, their breath momentarily halting!
"Emperor-level! Genuine Emperor-level aura! How is it possible?"
"Celestial Fall, what did you do?"
Yet, before their shock was over.
Beside him, Dragon War also erupted with aura independent of Celestial Fall.
"Another Emperor-level!"
"Wasn’t it said that breaking through to Emperor-level is extremely difficult? If the power of rules is insufficient, even if strength is achieved, Emperor-level power can’t be exerted?"
"Damn it! What’s happening?"
The aura of two Emperor-levels enveloped the Void, directly shrouding all True Gods’ aura.
Celestial Fall couldn’t be bothered to explain to these guys.
Previously, he was single-handedly beaten, feeling utterly stifled.
Now, Celestial Fall finally found an opportunity to counterattack, he shouted, "Die, all of you!"
Buzz!
From his three eyes, an unparalleled terrifying ray burst forth!
This ray seemed to slice through the Void.
The True Gods, once again trying old tricks, attempted to block Celestial Fall’s ray attack with their flesh bodies.
However, when their invincible flesh bodies contacted Celestial Fall’s ray from the eyes, they were instantly swept through without resistance.
Buzz!
Their palms were cleaved in two, and a line of blood appeared on every True God along the path.
All True Gods were bewildered, "This... How is it possible?"
"Is this... Emperor-level combat power?"
Next, their bodies were severed at the waist!
In the Void, instantly, dozens of bodies split into two appeared!
Simultaneously, Dragon War’s side saw the tail of the giant dragon sweeping across!
The four Ancient Demon Gods, which could be easily blocked before, seemed to be hit by the entire world at this moment.
The well-tempered flesh bodies of Ancient Demon Gods directly showed dense cracks when they contacted Dragon War’s tail,
"Bang! Bang-bang-bang!"
After several flesh sounds, the bodies of four Ancient Demon Gods were directly exploded!
The Emperor-level might was utterly displayed at this moment!
At the same time, the exploded bodies of the four Ancient Demon Gods swiftly coagulated.
Soon, the four Demon Gods reformed their bodies, gazing at Dragon War with shocked expressions.
"Is the gap really this wide?"
"Once at that level, middle-tier True Gods simply stand no chance!"
If not for the horrifyingly strong flesh bodies of the Abyssal Demon God, possessing the ability to rebirth from a drop of blood.
Just that wave, they would have already perished!.
Meanwhile.

Han Xing focused his mind, and four groups of energy flooded into everyone’s body through the line connecting them.
Suddenly, Celestial Fall, who was being besieged, widened his eyes.
He felt a surge of power within him, at least three times stronger than before!
In a dual fusion of the self-state, Celestial Fall nearly reached the Emperor Level!
Yet due to certain rule limitations, they could never break that limit.
But now, Han Xing’s Infinite Domain directly bypassed the rules, allowing Celestial Fall to possess Emperor-level combat power!
There is as much a chasm between Emperor-level and below as heaven and earth!
If the Nether Emperor had emerged from the Silent Star River then, Han Xing’s side would already have been defeated and wiped out.
At this moment, countless thoughts flashed through Celestial Fall’s mind.
He quickly understood; this was Han Xing’s described means of counterattack!
Celestial Fall’s three eyes opened wide, shockingly saying, "Well, well, well!
Just this hand makes this kid stronger than the Hunter, hahaha!"
At this moment, genuine Emperor-level aura burst from Celestial Fall!
All True Gods on the scene looked at Celestial Fall, their breath momentarily halting!
"Emperor-level!
Genuine Emperor-level aura!
How is it possible?"
"Celestial Fall, what did you do?"
Yet, before their shock was over.
Beside him, Dragon War also erupted with aura independent of Celestial Fall.
"Another Emperor-level!"
"Wasn’t it said that breaking through to Emperor-level is extremely difficult?
If the power of rules is insufficient, even if strength is achieved, Emperor-level power can’t be exerted?"
"Damn it!
What’s happening?"
The aura of two Emperor-levels enveloped the Void, directly shrouding all True Gods’ aura.
Celestial Fall couldn’t be bothered to explain to these guys.
Previously, he was single-handedly beaten, feeling utterly stifled.
Now, Celestial Fall finally found an opportunity to counterattack, he shouted, "Die, all of you!"
Buzz!
From his three eyes, an unparalleled terrifying ray burst forth!
This ray seemed to slice through the Void.
The True Gods, once again trying old tricks, attempted to block Celestial Fall’s ray attack with their flesh bodies.
However, when their invincible flesh bodies contacted Celestial Fall’s ray from the eyes, they were instantly swept through without resistance.
Buzz!
Their palms were cleaved in two, and a line of blood appeared on every True God along the path.
All True Gods were bewildered, "This...
How is it possible?"
"Is this...
Emperor-level combat power?"
Next, their bodies were severed at the waist!
In the Void, instantly, dozens of bodies split into two appeared!
Simultaneously, Dragon War’s side saw the tail of the giant dragon sweeping across!
The four Ancient Demon Gods, which could be easily blocked before, seemed to be hit by the entire world at this moment.
The well-tempered flesh bodies of Ancient Demon Gods directly showed dense cracks when they contacted Dragon War’s tail,
"Bang!
Bang-bang-bang!"
After several flesh sounds, the bodies of four Ancient Demon Gods were directly exploded!
The Emperor-level might was utterly displayed at this moment!
At the same time, the exploded bodies of the four Ancient Demon Gods swiftly coagulated.
Soon, the four Demon Gods reformed their bodies, gazing at Dragon War with shocked expressions.
"Is the gap really this wide?"
"Once at that level, middle-tier True Gods simply stand no chance!"
If not for the horrifyingly strong flesh bodies of the Abyssal Demon God, possessing the ability to rebirth from a drop of blood.
Just that wave, they would have already perished!.
Meanwhile.

chapters.title: Chapter 1054 - 524: Change the Future! Annihilate the Ancient Evil Gods! (Part 3)
paragraphs: Han Xing also applied 3 layers of Infinite Domain to the True God of Radiance, the Painful Empress.

Although they hadn’t reached the Emperor Level, they far exceeded more than half of the middle-tier True Gods.
The True Gods were incredibly shocked.
"What the hell happened?"
"Why have Dragon War and Celestial Fall, who were almost done for, suddenly broken through to the Emperor Level?"
"And what’s with these guys?"
However, before the shock of these True Gods subsided.
Han Xing applied three layers of Infinite Domain to all Territory Defense Towers!
At this moment, all Territory Defense Towers, after the boost from two pieces of Sun Crown Stele, increased by 200%.
Plus Han Xing’s Infinite Domain, increased by 300%!
Adding up to a total increase of 500%!
And it’s not just a simple 1+5!
You have to know, every creature in this world has a Defense Value.
Sixty thousand Defense Towers with an Attack Power of one million might not necessarily deal with True Gods.
While ten thousand Defense Towers with an Attack Power of six million can definitely blast True Gods to death!
In the next moment, Han Xing activated all the Defense Towers on the Sky Island without hesitation.
Buzz!
Terrifying energy swept across instantly.
In Han Xing’s vision, countless threads began to twist and distort, and the rules in the Void became agitated!
Nine thousand high-tier Defense Towers began adjusting their angles, and any True God they targeted felt a chill down their spine,
just then, Han Xing directly aimed at the three Ancient Gods in the Alternate Space.
At this moment, the three Ancient Gods who were continuously attacking the True God of Radiance and Painful Empress all felt their faces change dramatically.
"This kid’s Defense Towers are strange! Quickly, retreat!"
However, a faint smile appeared on Han Xing’s lips.
"Want to escape? You bastards, all stay here!"
The next moment.
A far more terrifying attack several times than before suddenly descended.
The endless Sea of Blood where the three Ancient Gods in the Alternate Space resided was instantly swallowed by terrifying energy.
At the same time, a dazzling white light appeared in the eyes of all True Gods.
They saw that the Sea of Blood began to evaporate rapidly.
The area covered by the white light seemed capable of purifying everything!
"Ah!"
"Damn it! What attack is this?"
"How did this kid’s Defense Towers suddenly become so terrifying?"
The terrifying screams of the Alternate Space Ancient Gods came through.
After the white light dissipated.
The Sea of Blood had completely disappeared!
And the three towering Ancient Gods, like blood and flesh planets, were nowhere to be seen.
The crowd only saw three Blood Cores appear in the Void.
These three Blood Cores, upon seeing Han Xing’s cannon aim at them again, immediately fled in terror like they had seen a ghost.
However, at this moment, Han Xing coldly ordered, "Radiance, lock them."
He knew these were the true bodies of the Otherworldly Evil Gods.
As long as these three Blood Cores were blasted apart, these Evil Gods would be completely annihilated!
Upon receiving Han Xing’s command, the True God of Radiance, whose power had surged, did not hesitate.
From him burst forth thicker chains of light than before, filling the entire Void.
At the same time, the Queen of Pain was continuously weaving a Divine Power Spider Web to firmly bind the three Blood Cores.
"Buzz! Buzz!"
The three Blood Cores spun madly, and even from such a distance, the True Gods could feel the anxiety and anger emanating from the Blood Cores.
However, no matter how angry they were, it was futile.
Because Han Xing’s second wave of attack was almost ready.
"Buzz!"
Terrifying energy beams appeared once again.
The chains of the True God of Radiance collapsed inch by inch, and the Divine Power Spider Web of the Painful Empress was directly melted.
Then, when the energy beams caught up with the blood cores, they heard three desperate cries from within.
"No!"
"But I am an Ancient God, an Ancient God that has existed for tens of thousands of years! In this Void, not even Emperor Level beings can kill me! How could I possibly die?"
"Damn it! Realm Master, save me!"
However, their voices were quickly drowned out by the energy beams.
In the next moment, the three Blood Cores exploded!
At the same time, the crowd seemed to see three blood-colored lines appear from the extremely distant depths of the Void.
These three blood lines seemed to pierce through the Power of Rules, weaving into the Net of Rules.
"What is that...?"
To the True Gods of the Silent Star River, this was something they had never seen before.
It was also their first time realizing that there were such blood-colored lines hidden within the holy Rule Network.
However, with the explosion of the Blood Core.
The three blood lines snapped directly.
Terrifying blood energy burst forth, dyeing the entire Void and even that Forbidden Star River blood-red.
At the same time.
In the Alternate Space World, that incredibly formidable being suddenly opened its eyes.
It looked up in shock, "Plague, Curse, Blood... actually died?"
"How is that possible?"
This formidable being’s eyes were filled with disbelief.
However, at this moment, the Holy Spirit Realm began to rain blood, a sign of the Ancient God’s fall.
"Could it be that an Emperor Level entity made a move?"
The existence in the Alternate Space was full of confusion, seemingly unable to imagine how this could happen.
In front of Han Xing, three system prompts appeared in succession.
[Successfully killed Alternate Space Ancient God: Plague]
[Due to your outstanding performance, extra reward: World Will: 300 layers]
[Note: Defense Tower kills do not earn Experience Value, Divine Power Value, Legendary Points, or first kill rewards.]
[Successfully killed Alternate Space Ancient God: Curse]
[Due to your outstanding performance, extra reward: World Will: 250 layers]
[Successfully killed Alternate Space Ancient God: Blood]
[Due to your outstanding performance, extra reward: World Will: 300 layers]
All three Ancient Gods were obliterated by him in one wave.
Although no Experience Value and other rewards were obtained, Han Xing received a total of 850 layers of World Will!

chapters.title: Chapter 1055 - 525: The Routed Divine Spirits, A Great Victory!
paragraphs: This time, Han Xing obtained a full 850 layers of World Will!
Plus the World Will he had gained from killing those Divine Spirits before.
The amount of World Will Han Xing possessed now had directly surpassed 1100 layers!
In other words, he could directly construct 11 Celestial Rail Strike Devices.
A strong look of joy appeared in Han Xing’s eyes.
"Nice! After this, I might actually have the combat power to deal with a High-tier True God!"
Of course, with just 11 Celestial Rail Strike Devices, it still wasn’t too safe to go against an Emperor-level existence.
After all, the combat power Celestial Fall had just displayed already proved that Emperor-level and Middle-tier True Gods were on completely different levels.
So Han Xing still needed more Celestial Rail Strike Devices.
Which meant he had to kill more Divine Spirits and True Gods.
However, these True Gods couldn’t be killed outright; even if their flesh bodies were blasted into powder, they would still undergo Rebirth from within the Rules.
So Han Xing’s gaze turned toward those hundreds of High-tier and Top-tier Divine Spirits in Silent City!
When, on that Sky Island, more than nine thousand cannons locked onto those Divine Spirits,
fear appeared in the eyes of all the Divine Spirits.
They realized something in an instant.
"Damn! This bastard’s going to use the Defense Towers to blast us!"
"Everyone, run!"
Those Divine Spirits cried out in shock!
The scene of Han Xing blowing up three Ancient Gods with just two shots was still vivid in their minds.
On the field, including those True Gods, no one dared claim they could block this wave of bombardment!
The Divine Spirits fled madly.
And just then, Celestial Fall suddenly stretched out his hand and made a grasping motion.
A terrifying Sealing Power descended, directly locking at least dozens of Divine Spirits in place.
At the same time, Han Xing’s Defense Towers were already about to launch their Attacks.
The Divine Spirits who were restrained all showed expressions of despair in their eyes!
The crisis of death enveloped them.
"Ah! Damn it!"
"Why me? I’m not willing to die!"
"Lord True Gods, save me!
This group of lofty Divine Spirits shouted in despair.
The True Gods of Forbidden Star River all sucked in a cold breath.

Just then, the True God of Yellow Sand quickly said in a deep voice, "Aurora, we can’t let him slaughter that many Divine Spirits. The loss is too great for us; it’ll cause a break in our True God line!"
The Aurora True God’s face was also ugly. "I know."
In that instant, the Aurora True God seemed to make some sort of decision.
It fully revealed its true body.
A Light-Inviting Bird with three heads, its size comparable to a star.
At the same time, the Defense Towers’ Attacks from Han Xing had already descended.
It was easy to imagine that the group of Divine Spirits who were restrained would not have even the slightest chance of surviving.
The Aurora True God instantly turned into a streak of flowing light, blocking in front of that group of Divine Spirits.
And at the last moment, it dispelled the control over those Divine Spirits’ bodies.
That group of Divine Spirits only heard a voice ring in their ears, "Run!"
The next moment, those Divine Spirits seemed to realize something and went all out, doing everything they could to flee this place.
"Buzz!"
A white light swept past, and the Aurora True God’s body turned into powder, dispersing in the Void.
It had actually used the price of dying once itself to save that group of Divine Spirits.
But even so, Han Xing still hit a few unlucky bastards.
"Crack! Crack!"
A few glowing Nerve Networks appeared in the sky, then snapped directly.
The system notification appeared.
[Successfully killed Ghost Shadow Demon Dragon Race: Nayik (High-tier Divine Spirit Level)]
[Because your performance in this battle was outstanding, you are awarded an additional 10 layers of World Will]
[Successfully killed Rotting Rat Beast Race: Melonu (Top-tier Divine Spirit Level)]
[Because your performance in this battle was outstanding, you are awarded an additional 20 layers of World Will]
[Successfully killed...]
After eight notifications in a row.
Han Xing once again harvested a total of 170 layers of World Will.
The amount of World Will he currently had on hand already exceeded 1300.
However, this was not his main gain.
In the sky, those eight strands of Power of Rules snapped.
In other words, this time Han Xing would be able to obtain another eight complete Rules.
However, he didn’t collect them immediately, but instead continued adjusting the Defense Towers on the Sky Island.
And as he shifted his aim, whether they were True Gods or Divine Spirits, terror appeared on all their faces!
"Damn! That brat wants to blast us again!"
"His Defense Towers can kill Ancient Gods, and even the Aurora True God was knocked into a fall with one shot. We absolutely can’t withstand it!"
"Run! Run!"
The next moment, all the True Gods and Divine Spirits began to collapse and flee in a panic.
They didn’t even care about the persuasion of the Power of Rules anymore!
At this moment, Dragon War was still fighting four Ancient Demon Gods.
However, as Han Xing’s turrets aimed at them,
these proud Ancient Demon Gods also chose to chicken out at this moment.
The four Demon Gods directly tore open the Void with their flesh bodies; in front of them, a passage leading to the Abyss Realm seemed to appear.
As for those True Gods from Silent Star River, they were also frantically charging into the Void at this moment.
Celestial Fall and Dragon War still wanted to give chase.
But Han Xing said from behind, "Don’t chase them. All of you, come back."
Hearing Han Xing’s voice, Celestial Fall, Dragon War, and the True God of Radiance all abandoned the thought of pursuing.
After all the True Gods left.
On the field, only Han Xing’s Sky Island remained, along with Celestial Fall and Dragon War.
And the True God of Radiance and the others.
Up to this point, this terrifying battle that had arisen because of Han Xing’s breakthrough, involving dozens of True Gods and even hundreds of Divine Spirits,
had ended with Han Xing’s breakthrough to Demigod as the trigger, in a complete and overwhelming victory!
On the field, everyone’s face carried a delighted smile.
Because they had done it!

chapters.title: Chapter 1056 - 525: The Divine Spirits in Rout, A Great Victory! (2)
paragraphs: In the face of such terrifying enemies, not only did he survive, but he also defeated them!
If this hadn’t actually happened, no one in the entire Void would believe it.
Cheng Jianyong, Shen Yun, Zhang Lianmeng, and Su Xiaoyang all watched Han Xing from the side.
They wore comforting smiles on their faces.
Han Xing nodded; given their relationship, there was no need for extra words.
Everything was understood in their hearts.
Then, Han Xing stepped into the Void, collecting all eight strands of Power of Rules.
The system prompt appeared.
[Obtained Rule: Hundred Transformations, Frost, Cyan Rattan...]
Han Xing nodded with satisfaction, then glanced at his Lingxiao Mecha.
Seven of them were already blasted to the brink of being scrapped.
The other three were almost completely wrecked as well.
These ten mechas were just lingering on a Divine Spirit Level battlefield.
If they had participated in the True God battle earlier,
fear not, they would have been blown to smithereens by now.
At this moment, Han Xing looked at the two True Gods in the sky and said,
"Thank you."
The three-eyed man chuckled lightly, "You’re welcome."
"Just now, was that your method after breaking through to Demigod?"
He was asking about Han Xing’s Infinite Domain.
Han Xing nodded, "Yes."
Celestial Fall showed a look of appreciation, "Very good, your method isn’t just a simple amplification, but one that ignores the boundaries of rules."
"The rules in this Void can’t constrain your Power, allowing us to acquire Emperor Level combat strength."
"That is an incredible ability.
In fact, Celestial Fall didn’t know that this was just one of the abilities Han Xing obtained after his breakthrough.
In addition, Han Xing could see the past and future through those strange lines.
He even had a vague feeling that he could enter that state back then.
Similar to Time Stop.
But this ability was a bit twisted, and how to wield it was something he himself didn’t know.
At this moment, the three-eyed man Celestial Fall asked again, "So, what do you plan to do next?"

Han Xing thought for a moment and replied, "Let’s recover from our injuries first, and once we’re almost healed, head straight to Silent City and make those guys hand over all the fragments of Hunter’s body."
"Then destroy Silent City, and after that, I’ll head back to the Holy Spirit Realm."
There were many things Han Xing needed to find.
The first being the clue given by the Dark Night Goddess regarding the Holy Artifact Battle Bow: Eternal Night.
It was said that this Holy Artifact Level battle bow was lost in the ruins of a Great World.
And that Great World was the production place of the Lingxiao Mecha.

"Didn’t break the defense?"

Everyone was confused.
Han Xing smiled, "Try your Ultimate Skill."

"Brother Xing, my Ultimate Skill combined with the Holy Artifact Battleaxe has a chance to make divine spirits fall, are you sure it’ll be fine?
Han Xing laughed, "Don’t worry, if I think I can’t handle it, I’ll have Radiance step in."
The True God of Radiance, who was healing at the side, nodded and said, "I’ll keep an eye out."
Upon hearing this, everyone relaxed.

In the next moment, terrifying blood-colored Divine Power gathered on the axe’s body.
"Sizzle... sizzle..."
This blood-colored Divine Power, like red lightning, greatly enhanced the power of this strike.
Then, Cheng Jianyong roared.
"Ultimate Skill! Three Extremes Axe!"
Swish! Swish, swish!
Instantly, three terrifying attacks were launched.
At the same time, Han Xing entered the Infinite Domain State again.
And he entered a peculiar vision.
He could clearly see Cheng Jianyong’s axe movements and the connection of Divine Power with his own body.
Even though its might was terrifying.
He didn’t perceive any significant danger.
So, Han Xing directly took the hit with his body.
Clang! Clang, clang!
After three muffled chopping sounds, a gust swept through.
In the void behind Han Xing, three vast cracks spanning millions of meters appeared!
Meanwhile, he himself stood unharmed on the spot.
The scene before him allowed Cheng Jianyong to breathe a sigh of relief while feeling a deeper sense of defeat.
"Wow! It’s impossible to play like this!"
"My strongest strike merely made Brother Xing take three steps back; it’s so disheartening!"
Shen Yun laughed, coming over to comfort him, "Alright, it’s perfectly normal."

He could clearly see Cheng Jianyong’s axe movements and the connection of Divine Power with his own body.
Even though its might was terrifying.
He didn’t perceive any significant danger.
So, Han Xing directly took the hit with his body.
Clang!
Clang, clang!
After three muffled chopping sounds, a gust swept through.
In the void behind Han Xing, three vast cracks spanning millions of meters appeared!
Meanwhile, he himself stood unharmed on the spot.
The scene before him allowed Cheng Jianyong to breathe a sigh of relief while feeling a deeper sense of defeat.
"Wow!
It’s impossible to play like this!"
"My strongest strike merely made Brother Xing take three steps back; it’s so disheartening!"
Shen Yun laughed, coming over to comfort him, "Alright, it’s perfectly normal."
"Don’t forget, Brother Xing’s breakthrough into demigod was incredibly terrifying; his Holy Artifact Battle Armor is a set.
You only have a Sacred Artifact Weapon, how can you compare to Brother Xing."
"In fact, pushing Brother Xing back three steps is already quite impressive."

chapters.title: Chapter 1059: Divine Skill: Instant Prison Shadow Kill, Boundary-Breaking Arrow_2
paragraphs: “Alright...”

“Xiaoyunzi, you can still laugh, do you know what this means?”
“It means Brother Xing’s defense has surpassed yours, and your position as the team’s tank is about to be replaced!”
Upon hearing this, Shen Yun froze, then seemed to realize this point as well.
“Damn, looks like you’re right, Brother Xing has overtaken my defense!”
Shen Yun looked dejected for a moment, but quickly regained his spirits!
“Don’t worry, I haven’t broken through to Demigod yet. Once I break through, I’ll surely reclaim the throne as number one in defense!”
Everyone burst into laughter.
The team’s atmosphere gradually became lively.
Meanwhile, Han Xing remembered something and asked the True God of Radiance, “Radiance, are those special areas you mentioned far from Silent City?”
Radiance had mentioned that those places could provide the power for legends to break through to Demigod.
It was said to be some places of inheritance.
Although not as strong as the four supreme inheritances, they were much more formidable than average Demigods.
Just below the supreme inheritance.

After a moment of contemplation, the True God of Radiance replied, “It was quite far before, but now that I’ve broken through to True God, with the protection of the master’s mysterious power, it will only take two or three days to get there.”
Han Xing smiled upon hearing this, “Alright, after we finish the matters here, let’s head to those places you mentioned, allowing Xiaoyunzi and Xiaoyang to break through as well.”

He glanced at his Legendary Points.
[Legendary Points: 4427]

System prompt appeared.

“Yes.”

Celestial Fall and Dragon War both raised their heads because they felt a familiar aura once again.
A white light fell into Han Xing’s mind.

It carried a blood-dripping longbow, shooting numerous demons and Evil Gods in the void.
[Success: You have successfully learned the Wild Ranger’s exclusive Divine Skill: Instant Prison Shadow Kill]
[Instant Prison Shadow Kill: Wild Ranger’s exclusive Divine Skill]

[Skill Effect: Under Endless Arrow Prison state, activating Instant Prison Shadow Kill effect transforms Endless Arrow Prison into Ultimate Shadow Prison, increasing attack power by 800%, and deals additional 100% true damage to targets with divine power value lower than yours;
After Ultimate Shadow Prison state ends, 100 clones can be created, locking enemies into an immobile state, dealing 100 times * 88% true damage to them; this skill can affect True God.]
Reading the lengthy description of the [Instant Prison Shadow Kill] skill, Han Xing was instantly stunned.
He didn’t expect the newly drawn skill to be so formidable!
Not only could it affect True God, but it could also pair with Endless Arrow Prison to become an upgraded version, the Ultimate Shadow Prison!
Most crucially, the skill has a final burst effect, simultaneously creating one hundred clones, then locking the enemy for the ultimate strike.
“Sounds like a method they use for the Fusion of the Self.”
“Seems this skill also pertains to the True God level.”
Ever since witnessing these True God’s battles, Han Xing had developed a clearer understanding of the essence of things.
Even when they were casting an opening move, Han Xing could roughly predict the effect of their moves.
At this moment, Celestial Fall and Dragon War gazed over, “You seem to have the aura of Demon Slaughter on you, do you have some connection with him?”
“Demon Slaughter?” Han Xing asked puzzled.
Celestial Fall nodded and said, “Yes, he is also from our Supreme Hall, a fairly reclusive guy.”
“But, his strength is undeniable, if he hadn’t died, he might also have been a Master of War Ghosts level entity.”
Han Xing nodded and replied, “I don’t know Demon Slaughter, I just learned one of his methods.”
Upon hearing this, Celestial Fall exclaimed, “Demon Slaughter’s method, could it possibly be Instant Prison Shadow Kill?”
Han Xing paused, “You know this?”
Celestial Fall chuckled and nodded, “Of course, back then, Demon Slaughter used this move to injure an Emperor-level existence with an initial-tier True God’s power.”
“So we’re all aware of its might.”
Han Xing suddenly nodded.
It turns out the [Instant Prison Shadow Kill] move is indeed very powerful.
What he’s drawing now are the signature skills of the Wild Ranger from all the past.
And now, he could continue to draw.
[Do you want to consume 1600 Legendary Points to draw the Wild Ranger’s sixth skill?]
“Yes.”
At this moment.
A fierce aura came from the void, seemingly wanting to pierce through this world.
The terrifying piercing power was far more formidable beyond count than the Beast of Calamity’s tail spike.
Even the True God of Radiance and Painful Empress, who were healing, were slightly taken aback.

chapters.title: Chapter 1060 - 526: Divine Skill: Instant Prison Shadow Kill, Boundary-Breaking Arrow_3
paragraphs: Then, that breath fell into Han Xing’s mind.
In an instant, he was filled with all kinds of terrifying memories.
This time, the vastness of the memories far exceeded any previous experience.
Han Xing saw a graceful female Hunter, wearing a chest armor that accentuated her slender waist.
However, her archery movements were so fierce, as if any obstruction would be shattered by her arrowhead!
A system prompt appeared,
[Extraction successful, you have successfully learned the Wild Ranger exclusive skill: Boundary-Breaking Arrow]
[Boundary-Breaking Arrow: Gather all your insights and release an unstoppable Destruction Arrow that ignores defenses below the Holy Artifact Level, dealing 18800% Destruction Damage to enemies;

If the Boundary-Breaking Arrow destroys the enemy’s flesh body, it will directly severely damage their Power of Rules, with a probability of directly breaking the rules and completely slaying the True God, cooldown time: 24 hours.]
Seeing the skill introduction, Han Xing’s pupils contracted again.
"Damn!"
His exclamation drew everyone’s attention.
Cheng Jianyong asked, "Brother Xing, what’s happening?"
At this moment, Han Xing still had a shocked expression.
The skill was just too terrifying.
Not to mention the terrifying damage coefficient, the second effect was the most terrifying part of this skill.
It could actually damage the Power of Rules, and even had a probability of directly breaking the rules, causing the True God to fall!
These means were simply unimaginable.
It’s known that the True God of Radiance and Celestial Fall couldn’t harm the rules when using [Ten Thousand Me].
In everyone’s subconscious, those Powers of Rules, the Tree of Rules were invincible.
Things that couldn’t be attacked at all.
But now, the skill description told Han Xing.
The Tree of Rules could be attacked, and could even cause the True God to fall completely!
This directly shattered Han Xing’s understanding.
Han Xing took a deep breath, then approached Celestial Fall and Dragon War.
The two looked at Han Xing in confusion.
Han Xing didn’t say much but slowly drew the bowstring.
At this moment, Han Xing saw the Tree of Rules belonging to Dragon War and Celestial Fall manifesting in the void.
Moreover, Han Xing had a premonition that he could pierce through this Tree of Rules with one arrow.
And as the controller of the rules, Celestial Fall would receive a strong backlash, possibly even directly falling!
Celestial Fall and Dragon War also felt a sense of crisis looming over them.
For a moment, their expressions were somewhat uncertain.
Celestial Fall exclaimed, "Damn! Kid, is that Tiffany’s Boundary-Breaking Arrow?"
Han Xing asked in confusion, "The person who created this move is called Tiffany?"
Celestial Fall nodded, "Yes, to be precise, her full name is Tiffany·Rou Dance."
"Amazing!" Han Xing sincerely admired.
Being able to create such a terrifying move, Tiffany deserved Han Xing’s sincere respect as a female hunter.
Celestial Fall nodded, "Indeed, Tiffany is a powerful hunter with talents comparable to the Master of War Ghosts, and it’s said she had also touched realms above Emperor Level."
"Tiffany spent her life fighting against the rules."
"She was born into a commoner family, in a world where nobles ruled everything, and a vast class gap decided everyone’s fate at birth."
"In her world, it’s rare for women to pick up weapons.
"Yet Tiffany not only picked up the bow and arrow but became the only female hunter in her village, showing astonishing talent."
"Tiffany’s exceptional archery caught the eye of a baron, who taught her even more exquisite archery."
"Tiffany seized the opportunity, practiced hard, her archery skills progressed by leaps and bounds, and soon she became the strongest female hunter in that territory."
"However, the good times didn’t last long. The baron coveted Tiffany’s beauty and tried to harm her."
"Tiffany refused to comply, so the baron ordered the killing of her family and everyone related to her."

"On that night, Tiffany seemed to see through the nature of this world. No matter what you gave to the nobles, no matter how much benefit you brought them, as long as you’re not a noble, you are doomed to live humbly, not even controlling your own life."
"Tiffany understood this and chose to kill the baron, paving the way to overthrow the noble rule."
"Many things happened later, as you know, it’s difficult to fight against the ruling class of the entire world alone."
Han Xing nodded, he naturally understood this.
Celestial Fall continued, "But fortunately, Tiffany’s world had magic, Fighting Spirit, ways to continuously grow personal power."

"Tier Four wasn’t enough, so she advanced to Tier Five, Tier Five wasn’t enough, so she fought to Legend Level, then Tiffany reached the most powerful position in that world, successfully killed the decaying monarch of that world, and overthrew the rule between nobles and commoners."
"However, she didn’t expect that the world she was in was actually just a divine spirit’s backyard, and even the power she possessed was granted by this divine spirit."
"This divine spirit valued Tiffany’s talent and wanted her to become the new puppet."
"But Tiffany’s strong nature meant she wouldn’t yield to the divine spirit."
"The price was, Tiffany was stripped of all her powers."
"In short, after experiencing many things, Tiffany left her world and met the Hunter."
"This woman quickly regained her strength, returned to her world, and then killed that divine spirit."

At this point, a trace of regret appeared on Celestial Fall’s face, "However, before she could savor the joy of liberating all the commoners, the True Gods of that Forbidden Land were planning their return, intending to usher in the so-called Era of Extinct Gods..."

chapters.title: Chapter 1061 - 527: The Ancient Era—The Fallen Pantheon
paragraphs: "Those True Gods from the Forbidden Land want to trigger the Era of Extinct Gods, and after Tiffany heard Hunter out, she joined the Supreme Hall without hesitation, then died in the final battle."
Speaking of this, Celestial Fall sighed. "I only casually mentioned a few turning points in her life. In truth, her experiences are far richer than we can imagine."
Han Xing nodded. Just from a few casual words from Celestial Fall, he could already imagine how much that woman had gone through.
Just as Celestial Fall said, Tiffany spent her whole life fighting against Rules.
She refused to live as a slave just because she was born that way.
She fought against class, fought against Divine Spirits, and even after arriving in the Endless Void, she kept fighting against fate.
No wonder her Archery was called the Boundary-Breaking Arrow.
With this Skills in hand, Han Xing now had a way to seriously wound a True God.
At this moment, Dragon War, who’d barely spoken, sneered. "Han Xing, don’t listen to this brat Celestial Fall hyping Tiffany up like she was the second coming."
"She was indeed stunning, but she wasn’t at that ’unmatched in all ages’ level."
"This brat Celestial Fall had a crush on Tiffany. Before he could confess, she died in battle."
"So all these years, Celestial Fall’s never gotten over it. He even hugs her Bow and Arrow to sleep every day. Sometimes I seriously think he’s a damn pervert!"
Hearing Dragon War’s scoop, Han Xing’s face was full of shock.
"Senior Celestial Fall, that actually happened?"
Celestial Fall’s face went black. "Dragon War, what the hell, why do you spill everything?"
"And I did not hug her Bow and Arrow to sleep. I just take it out to look at it at night. Don’t make me sound that twisted!"
Dragon War just rolled his eyes at him. "Is there a difference? You’re still clutching Tiffany’s relic every day, taking it out from time to time to fondle it, aren’t you?"
Celestial Fall’s expression grew even uglier.
Han Xing laughed out loud and didn’t bother watching them bicker anymore; he left the spot.
At this point, the gains from breaking through to Demigod were basically wrapped up.
Han Xing evaluated his own combat strength.
Uh... seems like he couldn’t really evaluate it.
After all, his current combat power was wildly fluctuating.
When he didn’t activate anything, his combat strength was roughly equal to a Top Demigod.
If he entered Burst State, he could go fifty-fifty against a Divine Spirit; and if he added all sorts of Holy Artifact effects and Burst Skills... then it’d be anyone’s guess.
Time passed slowly.
Very soon, a whole day had gone by.
The next day...
Everyone’s injuries had basically recovered.
They all gathered around Han Xing, waiting for his next order.
Han Xing said straight out, "Let’s go. Head to Silent City."
As his words fell, Han Xing directly unleashed Infinite Domain, applying State buffs to everyone.
In an instant, they all felt that surge of Power roaring up again.
Celestial Fall couldn’t help sighing. "This Power is really incredible."
"It’s not some ordinary buff, but a kind of fundamental enhancement. Like, before, I could only unleash a fusion of the Self at 100 layers."
"With this Power’s amplification, I can crank Fusion of the Self up to 300 or even 400 layers. It’s absurd."
Even Dragon War, usually silent and ruthless, gave a slight nod.
The next moment, Celestial Fall directly released his Divine Power, wrapping Han Xing’s entire Sky Island.
In an instant, they entered a kind of space-time Teleportation State.
It was equivalent to a Divine Demon Battleship performing infinite Teleportation—terrifyingly fast!
And this was the Movement Speed of a Middle-tier True God.
From here to Silent City would only take twenty minutes.
Now, after Han Xing’s Infinite Domain amplification, that time was cut down drastically again.
They sped ahead at full tilt.
After only two or three minutes, they saw that enormous giant wolf corpse.
Another two or three minutes later, they arrived atop the giant wolf’s corpse.
But something Han Xing hadn’t expected: Silent City, which had once gathered creatures from over a hundred worlds, was now eerily quiet, without a single figure in sight.
Not only that, most of the buildings had been dismantled.
It had become a dead, deserted place.
Han Xing frowned, puzzled. "Those guys ran?"
The others also stared at the scene before them, faces full of confusion.
Celestial Fall nodded. "Yeah. After yesterday’s battle, those True Gods and Divine Spirits already knew they weren’t our match."
"And they also knew you’d definitely come looking for them, so they took their tribes and bolted overnight. Makes sense, honestly."
"But they did leave Bai Feng’s corpse behind. Probably afraid we’d come after them about him."
Han Xing said in realization, "So this giant wolf is called Bai Feng?"
"Yes."
At this point, Celestial Fall paused. "The True God of Yellow Sand is actually fairly sensible. He knew our target was Bai Feng."
"That saves us the trouble of chasing them through the Void."
But Han Xing seemed to remember something. "Wait, that’s not right! Besides this giant wolf’s corpse, fragments of Hunter’s body are still in those guys’ hands!"
"They took Hunter’s body fragments with them!"
"Radiance, search for those True Gods’ aura. We’re going to chase those bastards in the Void!"
The True God of Radiance had just been about to act,
when Celestial Fall waved his hand beside him. "Hold on. I think I’ve sensed Hunter’s aura."
As his words fell, Celestial Fall directly reached out a big hand, probing into the white giant wolf’s back.
Not long after, a middle-aged man’s corpse appeared.
Most of his body was intact, save for a missing arm.
Celestial Fall sighed. "That guy Yellow Sand really is pretty smart. After dealing with him for so many years, he knows my goal is Hunter’s corpse and Bai Feng."

"Dragon War, what the hell, why do you spill everything?"
"And I did not hug her Bow and Arrow to sleep.
I just take it out to look at it at night.
Don’t make me sound that twisted!"
Dragon War just rolled his eyes at him.
"Is there a difference?
You’re still clutching Tiffany’s relic every day, taking it out from time to time to fondle it, aren’t you?"
Celestial Fall’s expression grew even uglier.
Han Xing laughed out loud and didn’t bother watching them bicker anymore; he left the spot.
At this point, the gains from breaking through to Demigod were basically wrapped up.
Han Xing evaluated his own combat strength.
Uh... seems like he couldn’t really evaluate it.
After all, his current combat power was wildly fluctuating.
When he didn’t activate anything, his combat strength was roughly equal to a Top Demigod.
If he entered Burst State, he could go fifty-fifty against a Divine Spirit; and if he added all sorts of Holy Artifact effects and Burst Skills... then it’d be anyone’s guess.
Time passed slowly.
Very soon, a whole day had gone by.
The next day...
Everyone’s injuries had basically recovered.
They all gathered around Han Xing, waiting for his next order.
Han Xing said straight out, "Let’s go.
Head to Silent City."
As his words fell, Han Xing directly unleashed Infinite Domain, applying State buffs to everyone.
In an instant, they all felt that surge of Power roaring up again.
Celestial Fall couldn’t help sighing.
"This Power is really incredible."
"It’s not some ordinary buff, but a kind of fundamental enhancement.
Like, before, I could only unleash a fusion of the Self at 100 layers."
"With this Power’s amplification, I can crank Fusion of the Self up to 300 or even 400 layers.
It’s absurd."
Even Dragon War, usually silent and ruthless, gave a slight nod.
The next moment, Celestial Fall directly released his Divine Power, wrapping Han Xing’s entire Sky Island.
In an instant, they entered a kind of space-time Teleportation State.
It was equivalent to a Divine Demon Battleship performing infinite Teleportation—terrifyingly fast!
And this was the Movement Speed of a Middle-tier True God.
From here to Silent City would only take twenty minutes.
Now, after Han Xing’s Infinite Domain amplification, that time was cut down drastically again.
They sped ahead at full tilt.
After only two or three minutes, they saw that enormous giant wolf corpse.
Another two or three minutes later, they arrived atop the giant wolf’s corpse.
But something Han Xing hadn’t expected: Silent City, which had once gathered creatures from over a hundred worlds, was now eerily quiet, without a single figure in sight.
Not only that, most of the buildings had been dismantled.
It had become a dead, deserted place.
Han Xing frowned, puzzled.
"Those guys ran?"
The others also stared at the scene before them, faces full of confusion.
Celestial Fall nodded.
"Yeah.
After yesterday’s battle, those True Gods and Divine Spirits already knew they weren’t our match."
"And they also knew you’d definitely come looking for them, so they took their tribes and bolted overnight.
Makes sense, honestly."
"But they did leave Bai Feng’s corpse behind.
Probably afraid we’d come after them about him."
Han Xing said in realization, "So this giant wolf is called Bai Feng?"
"Yes."
At this point, Celestial Fall paused.
"The True God of Yellow Sand is actually fairly sensible.
He knew our target was Bai Feng."
"That saves us the trouble of chasing them through the Void."
But Han Xing seemed to remember something.
"Wait, that’s not right!
Besides this giant wolf’s corpse, fragments of Hunter’s body are still in those guys’ hands!"
"They took Hunter’s body fragments with them!"
"Radiance, search for those True Gods’ aura.
We’re going to chase those bastards in the Void!"
The True God of Radiance had just been about to act,
when Celestial Fall waved his hand beside him.
"Hold on.
I think I’ve sensed Hunter’s aura."
As his words fell, Celestial Fall directly reached out a big hand, probing into the white giant wolf’s back.
Not long after, a middle-aged man’s corpse appeared.
Most of his body was intact, save for a missing arm.
Celestial Fall sighed.
"That guy Yellow Sand really is pretty smart.
After dealing with him for so many years, he knows my goal is Hunter’s corpse and Bai Feng."

chapters.title: Chapter 1062: The Ancient Era, The Fallen Pantheon (Part 2)
paragraphs: “So he went to each major Race, gathered the fragments of Hunter’s body, pieced them back together, and then stayed here waiting for us to take them away.”
But when Celestial Fall looked at Hunter’s arm, he frowned and said, “Why is there still a piece missing?”
Han Xing didn’t speak. He took that section of arm out of his backpack and attached it.
At this moment, Hunter’s deathly pale face seemed to gain a hint of spirit, as if he were still alive.
However, Han Xing knew very clearly that this man was truly dead.
Up to now, Han Xing had already retrieved everything on Silent City’s side, so he had perfectly completed his objective.
Celestial Fall asked, “What are you planning next?”
Han Xing thought for a moment and said, “First let my team members break through to Demigod, then make a trip back to the Holy Spirit Realm.”
Celestial Fall nodded. “In that case, leave Hunter and Bai Feng’s corpses to me.”
Han Xing was stunned. “You’re not coming with us?”
Celestial Fall smiled. “We have our own things to do.”
“Besides, with Emperor Level beings not showing themselves for now, the Power at your side is already enough to handle many dangers.”
Han Xing nodded.
Right now, using the Infinite Domain together with two True Gods and the Defense Tower, he was enough to deal with at least four or more Middle-tier True Gods.
And next, he would also construct many Celestial Rail Strike Devices, so his strength could rise another wave.
Celestial Fall continued, “But I need to remind you, that so-called Era of Extinct Gods those guys mentioned is getting closer and closer.”
“Also, this time, because of blocking the Nether Emperor, the Star River seal Hunter left behind consumed far too much Energy.”
“It won’t be long before Emperor Level beings, or existences even stronger, may appear.”
“If it’s Emperor Level, Dragon War and I working together, plus your Power, can still barely resist for a while.”
“If it’s above Emperor Level...”
Han Xing asked doubtfully, “What happens if it’s above Emperor Level?”
Celestial Fall spread his hands. “Then we’d better start thinking about how we’re going to die.”
He seemed to have no thought of resisting anything above Emperor Level.
Han Xing asked, puzzled, “Above Emperor Level... what realm is that exactly?”
Celestial Fall shook his head. “Specifically, I’m not too sure either. Even in our Supreme Hall, only two or three have reached that realm.”
“But every one of those beings roams the Void freely, and can destroy a Great World with a flick of their finger.”
“Just take the Master of War Ghosts as a reference—he’s killed an Emperor Level existence before!”
Hearing that last sentence, Han Xing was shocked in his heart, but after learning Tiffany’s [Boundary-Breaking Arrow], he also understood that True Gods could be killed.
Then Celestial Fall and Dragon War took their leave of Han Xing.
These two Hunters from the Supreme Hall, carrying the giant wolf and Hunter’s corpse, disappeared into the Void.
After they left, Han Xing fell into a State of contemplation.
Celestial Fall’s final reminder put some pressure on Han Xing.
He had originally thought that after he broke through to Demigod, he would be invincible for a long time; now it seemed he was still far from enough.
He needed to grow stronger even faster.
Besides improving the Defense Towers, both he himself and his teammates’ strength all needed to be raised.
Thinking this, Han Xing had already made up his mind.
Then he said, “Move out! Head to that Forbidden Land Radiance mentioned and let you all break through!”
At the same time, after Celestial Fall and Dragon War left, Han Xing had nothing else to do in Silent City.
So Han Xing directly said, “Radiance, let’s go. Take us to those Forbidden Lands you mentioned, let Xiaoyang and Shen Yun break through, and then we’ll make a trip back to the Holy Spirit Realm.”
The True God of Radiance nodded. “Alright, Master.”
With that, he spread his Divine Power over the Sky Island where Han Xing and the others were, as well as the Divine Demon Battleship, once again entering that Infinite Teleportation State.
Although slightly slower than Celestial Fall’s Movement Speed, it was roughly equivalent to the Divine Demon Battleship’s Infinite Teleportation speed.
The scenes in the Void rapidly receded.
After only a single day, they arrived at a region filled with the aura of death.
It was as if many Divine Spirits and True Gods had fallen here; the powerful resentments had even turned this place into a land of Resentful Spirits wailing.
Han Xing’s expression was strange. “Radiance, this is the place you were talking about?”
The True God of Radiance nodded. “Yes, Master.”
“This is a place I discovered by accident. Its era is extremely ancient, even older than the time before the Age of Ten Thousand Gods.”
“And these dead Divine Spirits, we don’t even know which era they’re from—they’re more ancient than us old geezers.”
Hearing Radiance call himself an old geezer, everyone couldn’t help but laugh.
At this moment, Shen Yun asked doubtfully, “Then what does this have to do with our upcoming breakthroughs?”
Radiance smiled. “Of course it’s related.”
“These old geezers seem to have died in some unknown catastrophe. Regretting that their own Power had no one to inherit it, they turned into one inheritance Land after their deaths.”
“They’ve been waiting for some opportunities—for descendants whose Talent is strong enough—to accept their Power.”
“Including me. Back then, I also received the inheritance of one of the beings here, then successfully broke through to Demigod, and later made a single leap to True God.”
Understanding dawned in Han Xing’s eyes, and at the same time he quietly grew more vigilant in his heart.
At present, the oldest era known in the Holy Spirit Realm was the Age of Ten Thousand Gods.
Yet the True God of Radiance, a Divine Spirit who had survived since the Age of Ten Thousand Gods, said that once, a batch of Divine Spirits even more ancient than him had fallen here.
Han Xing didn’t know whether this batch of Divine Spirits came from the Holy Spirit Realm.
Of course, they might also have come from some other Great World.

chapters.title: Chapter 1063 - 527: The Ancient Era - The Fallen Pantheon (Part 3)
paragraphs: After all, the Void is vast and boundless, and no one knows how long it has existed. It is only natural that a world as powerful as the Holy Spirit Realm would be born here.
Han Xing looked at the area in front of him, where there was nothing but an endless aura of death and clusters of stars emitting light.
The energy released by these star clusters varied in color and size.
Some appeared as small as an asteroid, while others were as vast as a solar system, seemingly infinite.
Han Xing asked, "There are so many star clusters here; how should we search for the inheritance of the ancient gods?"
"And, how do we determine if the inheritance of these ancient gods is strong or weak?"
The True God of Radiance laughed, "I have a way."
"When I accidentally discovered this place years ago, I stayed here for many years and interacted with many Inheritance Powers."
"Each star cluster here represents a type of inheritance, and the Power contained within varies."
At this point, the True God of Radiance paused, seemingly reminiscing.

A moment later, he continued, "Of course, it’s not just that the bigger the star cluster, the stronger it is; you also need to study the intensity of the Energy it emits and whether it’s the most suitable inheritance for you."
"But one thing is certain: the deeper you go, the larger the star clusters become, which also means the inheritance is more powerful."
"You don’t need to pay much attention to these inheritance star clusters in the edge region."
"Their inheritance can at most allow someone to break through to regular Divine Spirit level."
"Back then, I kept delving into this mysterious area."
"At that time, I was reckless and plunged deeper."
"Thinking back now, my behavior really was akin to seeking death."
The True God of Radiance smiled wryly and shook his head.
"Later, after delving several million kilometers, I finally found an inheritance sufficient to break through to High-tier Divine Spirit level, which then led to the creation of the God of Radiance."
Shen Yun listened and asked in confusion, "Then why didn’t you be bolder back then and directly look for a True God’s inheritance?"
The True God of Radiance laughed wryly, "I wanted to, but the deeper you go, the more dangerous it becomes."
"Even after death, a trace of resentment from those mighty existences could obliterate me countless times back then, so I stopped before that inheritance."
Everyone nodded in realization.
"However, I am not who I used to be, and with the power bestowed by the master, perhaps I can lead you to the deepest part of this region."
"Back there, I once sensed many terrifying auras. According to my memories, they were at least at Emperor level, or even above Emperor level."
Hearing this, Han Xing nodded.
He also felt a strange sensation in his heart.
Even the invincible Emperor level and above fell here.
The battle back then must have been terrifying!
They didn’t even know what happened.
Shake his head, Han Xing said, "Let’s go, lead us there."
The True God of Radiance nodded, then enveloped the entire Sky Island with Divine Power and led everyone deeper into this star cluster-filled Void.
As they traveled, they encountered various illusions and strange energies that tested or attacked them.
But with the protection of the True God of Radiance’s Power, they could smoothly navigate through.
After advancing almost several million kilometers, the Energy of the star clusters here had already reached High-tier Divine Spirit level.
Each star cluster represented an ancient inheritance.
The Radiance said at this time, "Here is where I reached, the farthest place, Master."
Han Xing nodded and then asked, "How far is it to the core region?"
Clearly, merely inheriting at the High-tier Divine Spirit level didn’t appeal to Han Xing.
If possible, this time he aimed to find the strongest inheritance.

The True God of Radiance sensed carefully and replied, "I can feel many strong Energy fluctuations faintly coming from ahead, but we need to keep advancing; at least one or two days’ journey is required."
Considering the Movement Speed at True God level, to take one or two days shows how vast this region rich in inheritances is.
Han Xing nodded and said, "Then let’s go, directly to the core region."
"I will amplify your Power.
Upon hearing this, joy appeared on the face of the True God of Radiance.
Han Xing’s Infinite Domain amplification is truly marvelous, making the True God of Radiance almost fall in love with this sensation.
Meanwhile, a ball of light fell upon the Radiance.
In an instant, the aura of the Radiance surged several times!
Then, he transformed into a streak of light and began rapidly advancing forward.
Time slowly passed, and soon, a day had gone by.
And they finally arrived at the deepest part of this inheritance land.
This was an area of void.
Not just the void of various materials, but also the void of Energy and Rule.
Here, Han Xing and the others couldn’t even feel the constraints of the Rule upon them.
Only clusters of all kinds of colors floated in the Void, appearing wonderfully intricate.
"This is it, Master."
"Each star cluster here represents the inheritance of an existence."
"Their Power after death turns into forbidden zones; entering a star cluster initiates a trial."
"But, if your potential is not recognized, even possessing True God Power won’t let you enter."
Han Xing asked, "Then how do you gain recognition?"
The True God of Radiance laughed, "It’s simple; let Shen Yun and Ms. Su Xiaoyang release their Power towards the star clusters."
"If the star cluster acknowledges your Power and potential, it will automatically guide you into the inheritance cluster. Of course, you can refuse."
"If not accepted, there will be no reaction."

chapters.title: Chapter 1064: Ingenious Uses of the Infinite Domain, Exploiting Bugs!
paragraphs: Han Xing suddenly nodded.
He looked at the dozen or so star clusters of varying sizes and colors in front of him.
Each star cluster emitted a different aura.
Some were gentle like flowing water.
Some were fierce like a raging wind.
Others were serious like order, cold as ice.
After contemplating for a moment, Han Xing made a decision.
He turned and said, “Xiaoyunzi, Xiaoyang, try to get close to these star clusters. If you sense an aura that resonates with your power, try to release your power to see if you can gain recognition.”
“If not, try each one.”
“Okay!”
“Got it, Brother Xing.”
The two nodded, then started sensing the power of these star clusters as Han Xing instructed.
Soon, Su Xiaoyang sensed a star cluster brimming with life force.
“Han... Brother Han Xing...”
Su Xiaoyang called out softly.
Han Xing turned and asked, “What’s up, Xiaoyang?”
Su Xiaoyang extended her slender arm and pointed to a green star cluster ahead, “I... I want to try that one.”
Han Xing nodded, “No problem.”
“Radiance, take us over there.”
The True God of Radiance swiftly released divine power, helping everyone approach.
Then, Su Xiaoyang whispered, “What... what should I do?”
The True God of Radiance replied with a gentle smile, “Just unleash your strongest attack at the star cluster.”
Hearing this, Su Xiaoyang slowly nodded.
To be honest, she didn’t really have any particularly strong attack methods.
Su Xiaoyang’s skills: Tree of Life, Void Vine, etc., are all support skills.
In the team, she usually played a support role.
However, she possessed a complete set of Abyssal Magical Artifacts, making her attack power quite impressive.
The next moment, Su Xiaoyang took a deep breath, her full chest slightly heaving.
Then, she gathered all her power and shot a green-hued arrow, which landed in the green star cluster.
Whoosh!
A moment later, the star cluster trembled.
Everyone waited silently.
A few seconds later, Su Xiaoyang’s mouth slightly opened, exclaiming, “Han... Brother Han Xing...”
“Did it succeed?” Han Xing asked.
Su Xiaoyang nodded, “It succeeded...”
“I heard a system prompt saying I’ve gained the recognition of the Four Seasons Goddess and can start the basic trial!”
She clenched her small fist, speaking excitedly.
Everyone’s faces also showed satisfaction.
However, Han Xing appeared thoughtful.
“The Four Seasons Goddess, basic trial?”
“It seems there are higher-level trials, but due to Xiaoyang’s lack of power, she couldn’t trigger them?”
At this point, Han Xing asked, “Radiance, have you heard of the Four Seasons Goddess?”

The True God of Radiance shook his head, “I haven’t heard of the Four Seasons Rule, but the Four Seasons is a powerful rule that encompasses spring, summer, autumn, and winter, representing rebirth, growth, fruition, and demise, symbolizing the cycle of all things.”
“It involves many kinds of rule power, with immense potential.”
“Judging by the scale of this star cluster, the power of this being in its prime was likely not below the Emperor Level, possibly even above!”
“If Ms. Su Xiaoyang receives this inheritance, cultivating to the Emperor Level would not be a problem!”
Han Xing nodded, indeed feeling this star cluster’s power suited Su Xiaoyang well.
However, he asked again, “Right, there’s another question.”
“Can Xiaoyang receive power augmentation from others during her attack?”
“Like Shen Yun’s blessing skills and your true divine power augmentation, could this enable a higher-level trial?”
