paragraphs: Han Xing listened and laughed!
Indeed, just as expected!
Su Xiaoyang, even within Legend, is not considered weak.
Although his abilities in all aspects tend to be supportive, he still has at least High-tier Demigod Level combat power.
Now, with Han Xing’s [Infinite Domain] enhancement, Su Xiaoyang leaps to the level of a Top Demigod.
For a Legend to be able to exert Top Demigod combat power, if such prowess can’t unlock the highest inheritance, then the trial requirements are really too high.
Han Xing nodded and said: "As long as it’s successful, it’s good."
"Now you should directly accept the inheritance."
"Mm mm!"
Su Xiaoyang nodded.
Then, she directly clicked accept.
In the next moment, a green light enveloped Su Xiaoyang and brought her into that green star cluster.
Moreover, because the [Infinite Domain]’s reinforcement is infinitely existent.
Even if Su Xiaoyang enters the inheritance, she can still maintain her combat power far exceeding Legendary Level, so there’s no need to worry about any accidents.
Han Xing couldn’t help but exclaim again, "The Infinite Domain is really overpowering!"
His Infinite Domain is the product after breaking rules, this Void can’t constrain him, let alone an inheritance place!
With this, the flexibility is indeed significant.
Not only Su Xiaoyang, but also Shen Yun can open the highest inheritance!
About an hour passed again, Shen Yun tested every star cluster in this area, searching for the most suitable inheritance for himself.
Cheng Jianyong urged: "Xiaoyunzi, hurry up, picking an inheritance takes so long."
Shen Yun turned around and rolled his eyes at him, saying: "What do you know, I must find the most badass, strongest inheritance."
"Then, watch how I crush you!"
Cheng Jianyong laughed, "You? Crush me?"
"Why don’t you take a look at my Immortal Giant and then say that?"
Hearing this, Shen Yun’s face instantly stiffened, "Damn! If you have the guts, don’t use Sacred Artifact Weapon, then I’ll definitely crush you!"
"Impossible! I’m a Supreme Hidden Profession, even without Sacred Artifact Weapon, I can still toy with you single-handedly, hahaha!
Cheng Jianyong laughed proudly.
Though very unwilling to admit it, what he said was indeed true.
At the same stage, purely in terms of combat power, only Zhang Lianmeng, who is also a Supreme Hidden Profession, can compete against him.
Shen Yun secretly made a decision to definitely find a powerful inheritance, even if he can’t defeat Cheng Jianyong, at least not be suppressed by him.
After his search, he finally saw a star cluster filled with majesty and holiness.
After sensing it, Shen Yun’s eyes suddenly brightened: "I feel this inheritance suits me well!"
"Brother Xing, I want this one!"
Han Xing nodded and then directly enhanced [Infinite Domain].
Shen Yun’s power got a tremendous boost!
With at least a tripling of his basic attributes, Shen Yun also smoothly opened the highest inheritance.
Then, both he and Su Xiaoyang entered the inheritance trial state.
While Han Xing and others couldn’t see what was in the star cluster, they didn’t know what this so-called trial was.
So they could only wait silently outside.
Time passed slowly.
In the blink of an eye, three days have passed...
During these three days, everyone felt a bit bored.
Cheng Jianyong even started a video call to chat with his daughter.
And on this day.
Han Xing could feel that the energy within those two enormous star clusters became increasingly turbulent, like an iron ball dropped into ice water, constantly boiling.
It seemed to have finally reached a critical point.
In the next moment, with the release of a wave of invisible energy.
Han Xing and others were astonished to see that these two enormous star clusters, each comparable to a galaxy in size, began to rapidly shrink.
All energy gathered toward the central area.
"Is it finally about to succeed?" Cheng Jianyong said excitedly.
Everyone immediately perked up and observed the conditions of those two regions.
Meanwhile.
In the center of the star cluster, both Shen Yun and Su Xiaoyang opened their eyes.
In the past three days, they have undergone various trials.
From power to spirit, and then to endurance and willpower.
They have undergone all sorts of trials.
Although not as overwhelmingly intense as Cheng Jianyong’s supreme trial, but no ordinary Top Demigod could complete it.
Then, both received a system prompt.
[Detection completed: Survivor Su Xiaoyang has completed the Four Seasons Goddess’s highest inheritance trials, meets breakthrough requirements, checking other conditions...]
[Level: Level 60 (meets requirements)]
[Profession: Hunter (meets requirements)]
[All advancement conditions met, would you like to absorb all Power of Rules in the Four Seasons Goddess inheritance to break through to Demigod Level creature?]
Since Su Xiaoyang is already a Hidden Profession, there won’t be a need like Cheng Jianyong and Zhang Lianmeng to change professions again.
Of course, the power obtained by breaking through to Demigod isn’t much weaker.
Su Xiaoyang directly clicked ’Yes.’
Simultaneously, within this star cluster radiating Four Seasons energy, all energy frantically surged into Su Xiaoyang’s body.
On Shen Yun’s side, he also received the same prompt.
[Detection completed: Survivor Shen Yun has completed the True God of Order’s highest inheritance trials, meets breakthrough requirements, checking other conditions...]
[Level: 60 (meets requirements)]
[Profession: Knight (meets requirements)]
[All advancement conditions met, would you like to absorb all Power of Rules in the True God of Order inheritance to break through to Demigod Level creature?]
Shen Yun also directly clicked confirm.
As time passed, Han Xing and others clearly felt two terrifying powers arising in the center of the star cluster.

paragraphs: They continuously absorbed the energy of this land of inheritance.
When the entire star cluster shrank to a single point, the aura of the two finally broke through a certain boundary.
Su Xiaoyang and Shen Yun both heard a system prompt.

[Breakthrough complete, you have become a demigod-level creature, successfully advancing to a Four Seasons Elf Shooter, with all attributes increased by 250%, and divine power value increased by 250%. The Four Seasons rule interface has been unlocked.]

[You have automatically learned new skills: Ultimate Skill — Breath of Spring (Passive Skill), Ultimate Skill — Fire of Summer (Passive Skill), Ultimate Skill — Withering of Autumn, Ultimate Skill — Winter’s Extinction.]
[Automatically learning combined ultimate skill: Seasonal Rotation.]

[Breakthrough complete, you have become a demigod-level creature, successfully advancing to an Order·Radiant Knight, with all attributes increased by 250%, and divine power value increased by 250%. The order rule interface has been unlocked.]

[You have automatically learned new skills: Ultimate Skill — Order Controller (Passive Skill), Ultimate Skill — Order Guardian (Passive Skill), Ultimate Skill — Order Apostle, Ultimate Skill — Light of Order.]
[Automatically learning divine skill: Divine Domain of Order.]
At the same time, a server-wide announcement echoed again.
System Announcement: “Attention all survivors, survivor: Clever Little Sheep, has completed the sixth transformation, becoming a new demigod-level powerhouse among Blue Star humans.”
“Let us congratulate this powerhouse for making a great contribution to the rise of the Human Race!”
System Announcement: “Attention all survivors, survivor: Yun Tianming, has completed the sixth transformation, becoming a new demigod-level powerhouse among Blue Star humans.”
“Let us congratulate this powerhouse for making a great contribution to the rise of the Human Race!”
The two consecutive breakthrough announcements completely blew up the chat channel.
Milk Puff: “Wow... two more have broken through, and there are now two more demigods!”
Chen Daniu: “Yes, now all five of Star God’s group have broken through to demigod, I’m really envious!”
Huang Huihong: “Envy +1, if I could have Star God’s help, I wouldn’t even ask for demigod; just breaking through to Legend would be nice!”
Caramel Chocolate: “What are you thinking above? Breaking through to Legend, right now other than Star God’s group, and Zhou Huang and Boundless, no one else is even level 50.”
“Moreover, Legend is already a rather impressive existence in this world, I suppose even Star God can’t help others break through?”
Other survivors also nodded in agreement.
In fact, for Han Xing, helping these survivors break through to Legend is not a difficult task.
The key from Tier Five to Legend is mastering divine power, which Han Xing can assist them with.
With the divine format and power of rules at his disposal, he can easily enable hundreds of Tier Five powerhouses to master divine power.
This was a feature Han Xing accidentally discovered after mastering [Infinite Domain].
But to break through to Legend, there is another key: they need to independently kill at least a Tier Five Lord, or even a Dominator-level creature.
This is something Han Xing cannot do for them; they must rely on themselves.
At that moment, Han Xing’s eyes lit up,
“Huh? Maybe it could work?”
You know, his [Infinite Domain] exists beyond the rules, unseen by even the system.
Helping Su Xiaoyang and Shen Yun before proved that point.
Is it possible then.
Han Xing could first use [Infinite Domain] to empower these survivors, helping them complete challenge tasks.
Then use the power within the divine format to give them divine power?
This way, Han Xing could even produce legendary-level survivors en masse!
Though survivors made this way might have subpar combat power.
But they are survivors!
As long as the number of legends is large enough, who cares about their quality, they can win by numbers alone!
Thinking of this, Han Xing first turned on global silence in the chat channel.
Then he sent a message.
“Everyone, I am Star River.”
“I can see your appeals.”
“Now, the Holy Spirit Realm is in crisis, and I think you all staying idle in the Witch Race Territory must feel quite restless.”
“But to participate in a war of this scale, you must at least have legendary combat power.”
“Therefore, I am making a promise here: the next 10 survivors to reach level 50 can come to me.”
“I will help you break through to Legend.”
With that, Han Xing turned off the global silence.
In the next moment, the chat channel messages flooded in.
“Whoa! Whoa! Whoa! Did I hear that right? Star God said he can help us break through to Legend!”
“Amitabha, I must have misheard, that’s Legend we’re talking about!”
“Yes, I heard from the Witch Race that it takes their entire race centuries to produce a single Legend, and Star God claims he can help us break through to Legend, and not just one!”
“This is unbelievable!”
At the same time, other survivors retorted: “What are you all talking about? When has Star God ever deceived us?”
“Although helping others break through to Legend seems far-fetched, for Star God, it’s not unimaginable.”
“Exactly, Star God has always been so surprising and powerful!”
“Brothers, stop wasting time! Hurry up and level up to 50!”
“Once you break through to Legend, you can roam the entire Holy Spirit Realm freely, and you can go to any race you want! You can marry a woman from any race you want!”
“Hahaha! That’s right, if I break through to Legend, I’ll marry an Elf, then have a Beast Eared Girl as a maid, and also find someone from the Fox Demon Race!”
The female survivors were also excited, “Ahhhh! I want to sleep with all the strong and handsome guys in the Holy Spirit Realm.”
“I want to sleep with Star God!”
“Brothers and sisters, charge forward!”

Then, Han Xing said, "Let’s go, back to the Holy Spirit Realm first."

Even though they wanted to go to that Great World right now.
But they were unconditionally aligned with Han Xing’s decision.

In an instant, they entered a unique state of Teleportation.
At True God Level movement speed.

Even if the True God of Radiance takes an entire Sky Island, it only takes two days.
Sounds long.

This speed is not just dozens of times faster!

Ripples continuously appeared in the Void.
In the blink of an eye, a day had passed...

The Elf Royal City almost got destroyed.

chapters.title: Chapter 1068 - 529: The Moment of Final Battle Arrives! (Part 2)
paragraphs: Beside him, the powerful member of the Frost Cold Leopard Race also spoke, "Indeed, our race’s legendary powerhouses have fallen by six, and demigods by three. As a small race, this has already halved the number of our strong members..."
"Moreover, we don’t even know when this war will end. At this rate, our race won’t be able to hold on!"
The various other major clans also began to express their grievances.
At the head of the meeting were the Elf King, the Dwarf King, and the Giant King.
The rulers of the three major clans cast a glance at them.
The Elf King sighed and said, "In fact, this war has been going on for so long, how could we not know that the major clans have suffered heavy losses?"
"Our three clans alone have lost over a hundred legendary powerhouses and twenty demigods."
"Even the old clan leader of our race exhausted his last bit of divine power to fend off the Demon God from the Abyss Realm and was swallowed on the spot by that Demon God!"
"Haven’t we spoken about these already?"
At this point, the Elf King’s tone gradually intensified, "In history, which war between the Abyss Realm and Holy Spirit Realm hasn’t been prolonged?"
"In the most severe times, even divine spirits were continually falling."
"And the power we have now is the weakest compared to previous wars between the two realms in history."
"At this rate, we can forget about direct confrontation."
"As soon as the Abyss Realm launches a full-scale offensive, at most we would hold out for a few days before total defeat."
Upon hearing the weighted and impactful words from the Elf King, the major clans fell silent.
Because they knew too, compared to them, the losses of the three major clans were even more tragic.
Entirely, the meeting room was filled with sighs.
At this time, a powerhouse from the Black Fin Tiger Race asked, "Elf King, is there any other way?"
"At this rate, we surely can’t outlast the Abyss Realm."
"If, according to what you say, the Abyss Realm invades massively, the Holy Spirit Realm will face extinction. We must prepare an escape route and method to respond.
"We can’t really wait here and let them destroy our clans, can we?"
This powerhouse uttered these words with a sigh, "Frankly, I’m not afraid of death."
"Everyone present here is a leader, standing here with the resolve to die in battle."
"More than death, what we fear more is national plight and extinction!"
Members of other races also sighed heavily.
The Elf King remained silent.
There are ways.
He knew the Holy Spirit Realm had hidden many old entities.
But these old entities could not take action.
Or rather, they only had one chance to act.
Once they act, these old entities might die on the spot due to complete exhaustion of power.
At this moment, another powerful member of the Flower Raccoon Rabbit Race said, "To speak of it, we haven’t seen any human race powerhouses for months."
"Ever since the battle with the Fearful Limb Demon God, they haven’t appeared again."
With this reminder, other powerhouses of various races also realized something, saying, "That’s right! Where has the Human Race gone?"
"I remember a human named Han Xing seemed to have the power to slay gods. If he were present, we wouldn’t have had to sacrifice so many demigods to fight against the Demon Gods of the Abyss Realm!"
"Elf King, where has the Human Race gone? You wouldn’t worry about him falling..."
The powerhouses of various major clans inquired.
The Elf King glanced at them, "I warn you all, Han Xing is my future son-in-law, slated to marry my daughter. Do not entertain any ideas about him."
Upon hearing this, Elinora, who was listening beside the Elf King, immediately blushed and lowered her head.
"Father..."
Elinora’s stunning appearance combined with her momentary shyness left the legendary figures and demigods on the spot awestruck.
"Ahem ahem!"
Someone coughed a few times,
"Elf King, so where has Han Xing gone?"
"Indeed, he hasn’t appeared for so many days, yet we are desperately fighting on the front line. He couldn’t be enjoying life at the back, could he?"
"If this human were here, our Black Sheep Divine Son wouldn’t have died fighting against the Demon God..."
When faced with this question, the Elf King hesitated to answer, as he found it difficult to respond.
At this moment, Elinora took a deep breath and stepped forward to say, "Gentlemen, you are all powerholders in your races, pillars of strength."
"I believe you all understand the principle that all tragedies stem from lack of ability."
"We can’t blame his sacrifice on our companions."
"Without Han Xing, during the appearance of the Fearful Limb Demon God, we would have suffered heavy losses."
"Han Xing is my future husband, and I do not wish to hear any words that disrupt the unity of the Holy Spirit Realm!"
Elinora’s tone was very stern, even more intimidating than her father, the Elf King!
Below, those who had just complained about Han Xing lowered their heads.
At this moment, Elinora continued slowly, "Moreover, though Han Xing hasn’t appeared, that doesn’t mean he has done nothing."
"He left behind the Witch Race and over a hundred legendary-level Thunder Beasts, as well as numerous defense towers."
"It was thanks to the power left behind by Han Xing that several times we managed to repel the Demon Gods and prevent further losses."
Upon hearing these words, everyone present also recalled something.
Indeed, there was a Sky Island with formidable firepower during these months of battles.
Several times it suddenly emerged, combining efforts with top powerhouses of the Holy Spirit Realm to vanquish the Demon Gods.
Everyone’s eyes revealed a sense of realization.
So... those Sky Islands were also the power left by Han Xing.

chapters.title: Chapter 1069 - 529: The Moment of Final Battle Has Arrived! (Part 3)
paragraphs: And just at this moment.
An Elf Race soldier suddenly burst in, looking panicked and said, "Your Majesty, the Elf King! Something terrible has happened!"
"Near Gem Island, there’s another large teleportation array!"
"And Windmill Island, Nanmo Island!"
"At least three places have large teleportation arrays!"
Upon hearing this, everyone’s hearts sank.
Three large teleportation arrays signify the descent of at least three Demon Gods.
With their power, even if they can deal with it, it would require a considerable loss!
However, the bad news doesn’t stop there!
Several soldiers rushed into the meeting, looking equally panicked.
They exclaimed, "Something terrible has happened! A large number of teleportation arrays have appeared in the Abyss Realm, and these arrays are different from before!"
"We saw some small arrays spliced with intermediate arrays, swirling madly around a large teleportation array, and we don’t know what they’re doing!"
Upon hearing this, the Elf King Wang Teng stood up.
He said with a serious expression, "This is bad! It’s a composite teleportation array, the Abyss Realm might be teleporting something terrible over!"
"Everyone, mobilize fully, quickly disrupt these arrays to thwart the Abyss’s scheme!"
However, before they could take action, the strong ones from various races suddenly received a communication.
After reading the contents of the communication, everyone’s faces changed dramatically!
They exclaimed in alarm, "Elf King! Something’s wrong!"
"Not only your Elf Realm, but Torrential Rain Canyon also has many Abyss Realm teleportation arrays!"

The strong ones from the Sand Scorpion Race also exclaimed, "News from our Hell Desert, there are three high-level teleportation arrays, along with many intermediate arrays, appearing in various places within our territory, and numerous Abyssal Monsters have already emerged!
"Our Dark Illusion Swamp is the same, tribe members report that various Abyss Realm warships have even appeared in our domain!"
The strong ones from various races reported the situations they encountered.
The entire meeting hall was chaotic, with the strong ones from various races extremely anxious.
The Elf King said heavily, "Everyone, the Abyss Realm has been plotting for a long time, this time they might be launching a full-scale attack."
"We must now do all we can to block the Abyss Realm’s invasion!"
Below, the strong ones from the major races asked, "Elf King, you speak lightly."
"But how are we supposed to block them?"
"In supporting the Elf Realm, we brought most of our strong ones out, now our race has only two legends left at home guarding."
"It’s the same for our Ice Claw Sea Monster Race! Although we have left one Demigod behind, we got news that a middle-tier Demigod Level Great Demon Monarch has appeared, now our race is in danger!"
"And us, the Divine Eagle Sea Monster Race!"
Hearing the anxious voices from various races, the Elf King demonstrated the spirit of a grand race and quickly commanded, "Everyone, I know you are very anxious right now."
"But we have long prepared for the Abyss Realm’s full-scale invasion."
"To handle this situation, our three major races have rushed to construct numerous teleportation arrays over the past few months, hidden on the Sky Islands surrounding the Elf Realm."
"These teleportation arrays have expended a lot of resources and are connected to most regions of the Holy Spirit Realm, enabling you to quickly return to your own camps."
"For those whose tribes are in urgent situations, I allow you to take some strong ones back."
Upon hearing this, the strong ones present brightened their eyes, they exclaimed joyfully, "Elf King, you actually had this up your sleeve."
"When were the teleportation arrays constructed, why didn’t we know?"
The Elf King glanced at them, "If you knew, would you have agreed to us constructing the teleportation arrays?"
"You guys treat your territories like forbidden zones, we had to put in a great effort to break through your realm’s spatial anchor points."
The strong ones present were stunned for a moment.
They knew the Elf King was telling the truth.
If the three major races had informed them earlier about establishing teleportation arrays in their territories, the majority of races present wouldn’t have agreed.
And now, the coercive measures of the three major races have solved their urgent crisis.
The Elf King continued, "I allow you to return, but you must leave some individuals to jointly defend the Elf Realm."
"If the Abyss Realm has really started their full-scale invasion, our Elf Realm will be their first target."
"Divine Eagle Sea Monster Race, you brought thirty legends and four demigods this time, some have died in battle, I allow you to return ten legends and one demigod."
"Sand Scorpion Race, you brought twenty-five legends and two demigods this time, I allow you to return five legends and one demigod."
"Illusion Deer Race..."
As the Elf King issued orders one by one.
The major races on the scene quickly acted.
Those who have survived till now are neither weak nor foolish.
They know that now is the time to act swiftly, with all strategies and actions implemented in the shortest time possible.
Then, the Elf King continued, "Now, for all races present, and the remaining strong ones among you, the subsequent coordination will be led by myself, the Dwarf King, and the Giant King!"
"We will split into three major corps, blocking the Abyss Realm’s army at three regions of the Elf Realm!"
"I hope, before the war ends, everyone must follow the command of us three major races."
"Otherwise, you’ll be dealt with by martial law!"
Everyone present recognized the seriousness in the Elf King’s voice!
And after these months of battles, they have already passed the initial period of adaptation.
In the face of the threat of extermination, all the strong ones on the scene shouted in unison.
"Yes!"
The Elf King took a deep breath and said, "Everyone! The moment of decisive battle is approaching!"

"For those whose tribes are in urgent situations, I allow you to take some strong ones back."
Upon hearing this, the strong ones present brightened their eyes, they exclaimed joyfully, "Elf King, you actually had this up your sleeve."
"When were the teleportation arrays constructed, why didn’t we know?"
The Elf King glanced at them, "If you knew, would you have agreed to us constructing the teleportation arrays?"
"You guys treat your territories like forbidden zones, we had to put in a great effort to break through your realm’s spatial anchor points."
The strong ones present were stunned for a moment.
They knew the Elf King was telling the truth.
If the three major races had informed them earlier about establishing teleportation arrays in their territories, the majority of races present wouldn’t have agreed.
And now, the coercive measures of the three major races have solved their urgent crisis.
The Elf King continued, "I allow you to return, but you must leave some individuals to jointly defend the Elf Realm."
"If the Abyss Realm has really started their full-scale invasion, our Elf Realm will be their first target."
"Divine Eagle Sea Monster Race, you brought thirty legends and four demigods this time, some have died in battle, I allow you to return ten legends and one demigod."
"Sand Scorpion Race, you brought twenty-five legends and two demigods this time, I allow you to return five legends and one demigod."
"Illusion Deer Race..."
As the Elf King issued orders one by one.
The major races on the scene quickly acted.
Those who have survived till now are neither weak nor foolish.
They know that now is the time to act swiftly, with all strategies and actions implemented in the shortest time possible.
Then, the Elf King continued, "Now, for all races present, and the remaining strong ones among you, the subsequent coordination will be led by myself, the Dwarf King, and the Giant King!"
"We will split into three major corps, blocking the Abyss Realm’s army at three regions of the Elf Realm!"
"I hope, before the war ends, everyone must follow the command of us three major races."
"Otherwise, you’ll be dealt with by martial law!"
Everyone present recognized the seriousness in the Elf King’s voice!
And after these months of battles, they have already passed the initial period of adaptation.
In the face of the threat of extermination, all the strong ones on the scene shouted in unison.
"Yes!"
The Elf King took a deep breath and said, "Everyone!
The moment of decisive battle is approaching!"

chapters.title: Chapter 1070: System Announcement Returns, The Road to War Begins
paragraphs: The Elf King slowly stood up from the throne and continued speaking solemnly.
“Compared to the Holy Spirit Realm thousands of years ago, we are very weak.”
“However, our desire to defend the honor of our race and continue the spark of civilization is not lost to any era!”
“Whether we face destruction or break through for rebirth depends on this moment!”
“The war has begun!”
Upon finishing his words, the Elf King took the lead, transforming into a stream of light and charging out!
The power that erupted in an instant seemed to faintly break through to the limit of a top demigod, reaching that level.
At the same time, the Dwarf King and Giant King also erupted with incredibly strong auras.
All the strong figures within the entire conference hall rushed out of the Sky Island.
They immediately headed to the battlefield where the Elf Realm was located.
Meanwhile.
In many corners of the Holy Spirit Realm, crimson teleportation arrays appeared one after another.
From these teleportation arrays, first, a pointed horn appeared, then a piece of white bone.
Flesh clung to the bone, along with various biological organs, drenched in fresh blood.
It looked like the front of a chariot.
When the strange object fully emerged, a white bone chariot loaded with a vast number of abyssal monsters appeared!
Besides this bone chariot, other teleportation arrays quickly churned out various Abyss Realm wartime tools.
Blood-skin windmills made entirely from the skins of various creatures.
And hellish sailboats continuously flowing with magma, as well as toothed discs, etc.!
These wartime tools were massive, with the smallest having a diameter of over a kilometer, and the largest exceeding ten or even a hundred kilometers.
On them stood a dense crowd of abyssal monsters.
The Demon Eye, resembling an eyeball, the Resentful Spirits full of anger, and the Giant Female Vengeful Spirit as large as mountains.
Also, the Inferior Demons, Abyss Knights, and so on...
The evil aura they exuded dyed the sky of the Holy Spirit Realm completely red.
On each wartime tool stood at least one Abyss Demon with Tier Five Lord Level power!
One demon, carrying a huge cleaver, looked at a Sky Island belonging to the Ghost-faced Wolf Race.
It sneered, “The Emperor commands us to destroy everything without reservation this time!”
“Kill all living beings active in the Holy Spirit Realm!”
“Everyone, enjoy the melody of this slaughter!”
Upon hearing these words, a large number of Resentful Spirits and Inferior Demons flew from dozens of white bone chariots.
Their silhouettes covered the entire Sky Island.
Over a billion members of the Ghost-faced Wolf Race were devoured by this group of abyssal monsters in three minutes.
Moreover, after their death, their souls were absorbed by a Demon Furnace on one of the white bone chariots.
As the flames of the Demon Furnace ignited.
A chilling scream that penetrated to the bone marrow rang in the ears of all abyssal monsters!
“So painful! So painful!!”
“Don’t burn me... Don’t burn me... I was wrong! I was wrong!”
“Father! Help me, the flames of these demons are so painful!”
The abyssal monsters seemed to enjoy it, standing still and quietly listening to the screams.
The flames... burned more fiercely...
Boom!
As a massive surge of flame rose.
In no time, the screams from the Demon Furnace subsided.
Tens of billions of lives were slaughtered, their souls refined into Soul Crystals!
It wasn’t just the Ghost-faced Wolf Race; similar events were happening in many regions across the Holy Spirit Realm.
Just as the Elf King mentioned, the Abyss Realm had launched a full-scale attack this time!
Nobody knew why, everything was so sudden.
And in the Elf Realm.
A massive teleportation array suddenly emerged with the head of a giant battleship.
This battleship was entirely blood-red, armed with numerous Flesh-Separating Cannons, Lava Burst Cannons, and Grudge Roar Cannons!
Additionally, the deck was crowded with Inferior Demons, Evil Eye Monsters, and the Demon Army!
If Han Xing were here, he would recognize that this was a Divine Demon Battleship of the same level as his own!
Behind this Divine Demon Battleship, a vast number of Hell War Chariots, Ships of the Dead, and Skeleton Bombardment Battleships appeared swiftly.
In the blink of an eye, the number surpassed ten thousand, forming a massive fleet of battleships!
The gaze of these abyssal monsters was equally frenzied.
A Great Demon Monarch with the power of a middle-tier demigod stood at the head of the battleship, seemingly the commander of this fleet.
It waved its massive hand and commanded, “Attack! Bombard every Sky Island and kill all living beings of the Holy Spirit Realm!”
Just then.
A giant war axe flew in an instant.
Swish!
The war axe sliced through the sky, directly severing the body of the Great Demon Monarch with middle-tier demigod power.
Then it cut through the deck, turning many Inferior Demons and Evil Eye Monsters into meat paste!
The Giant King arrived with his army, snorting coldly, “A bunch of Abyss Realm trash dares to act recklessly here.”
“Kill them all!”
With these words, a vast number of strong figures from the Holy Spirit Realm charged forth.
However, the group of Abyss Realm monsters showed no fear.
With eyes full of madness, they operated the various wartime tools at their feet, launching a frenzied bombardment.
The Hellfire Missile Silo erupted continuously.
The Skeleton Catapult, Undead Arrow Tower, Flesh-Separating Cannon, and others launched their attacks.
In the sky, countless flames sliced through the firmament.
Then smashed down on the Holy Spirit Realm United Army, causing a catastrophic explosion.
“Boom!”
Then, a group of enormous Hellfires appeared.

chapters.title: Chapter 1071 - 530: System Announcement Returns, The Path of War Unfolds! (Part 2)
paragraphs: Meanwhile, as the skeleton catapults crashed down, they turned into a sky full of skeletons.
These war machines, which Han Xing had already deemed obsolete, posed considerable obstacles to the Holy Spirit Realm army on such a large battlefield.
Yet, all of this was rendered insignificant by the Giant King’s absolute power.
He swung his giant axe, slashing horizontally.
Suddenly!
The fan-shaped space ahead, spanning tens of thousands of kilometers, was slashed open by him, creating a space rift!
On those battleships, war chariots, countless abyssal monsters, a line of blood appeared on their bodies.
Then they exploded violently.
"Puff! Puff puff puff!"
At least tens of millions of abyssal monsters perished with a single swing of his axe.
The Holy Spirit Realm United Army watched this scene, and their morale surged instantly.
They shouted loudly: "Giant King, invincible!"
"Charge!"
Right at this moment.
Another huge teleportation array appeared.
Before the Giant King could destroy it, a terrifying surge of magma erupted.
Boom!
This magma surged up to over a hundred thousand meters high.
The nearby abyssal monsters and creatures of the Holy Spirit Realm were directly melted into ashes.
Then, a dreadful Hell Demon God emerged.
It uttered an ancient, hoarse voice: "Holy Spirit Realm... It’s been four thousand years..."
"I, the Fire-Devouring Demon God, have returned today!"
"Last time, I refined a trillion souls at once, helping me break through to the Demon God Realm!"
"This time, I will refine a hundred times more Holy Spirit Realm creatures to break through to the Ancient Demon God Realm!"
Upon hearing these words, the faces of those from the Holy Spirit Realm changed slightly.
They all knew, this was a Demon God stained with countless blood from the Holy Spirit Realm!
Having divine-level combat power!
At this moment, the Giant King snorted coldly, "You call yourself the Fire-Devouring Demon God?"
"This time, encountering me, you will have no more chances!"
However, that Demon God merely glanced at the Giant King indifferently, then uttered, "Ant."
The Giant King wasn’t enraged; instead, he turned and said, "Dark Divine Son, take over commanding the battle, I will go kill it!
With those words, the Giant King instantly engaged in battle with this terrifying Demon God.
Not only that.
Numerous Demon Gods appeared in various regions of the Elf Realm!
The situation now is far worse than a few months ago when the Fearful Limb Demon God appeared.
Just like the Elf King said.
The Elf Realm is the center of the Holy Spirit Realm.
Even if the Abyss Realm launches a large-scale invasion, it would focus its core efforts here.
However, the situation is equally dire for other races.
In the Flame Plateau.
This area, with temperatures soaring to thousands of degrees Celsius, a rarely inhabited region, was equally occupied by overwhelming abyssal monsters.
They seem accustomed to the high temperatures here.
After all, in the Abyss Realm, conditions far more extreme than this are not uncommon.
A multitude of abyssal monsters surged up the Flame Plateau.
Those stone men were roused from their slumber, each letting out a roar.
"Damn it! Get out of our territory!"
"Roar!"
These stone men swung their fists, smashing group after group of abyssal monsters.
However, they were quickly submerged by more abyssal monsters.
The stone men perished one after another, their souls disappearing within the Demon Furnace.
Before long, that group of abyssal monsters advanced into the depths of the plateau.
At this moment, the Stone Giant Race Leader was besieged by three Great Demon Monarchs.
After a burst of energy, some hidden danger within it seemed to erupt.
Seizing the opportunity, one Great Demon Monarch shattered the Stone Giant Race Leader’s heart with a punch.
Another Great Demon Monarch slashed down the Stone Giant Race Leader’s neck, chopping off its head.
"Boom!"
The massive stone head fell to the ground, eyes wide open, seemingly unwilling to die in peace.
Yet in the next instant, its soul was absorbed by the Demon Furnace.
Ignition, refinement, in one swift motion!
The Stone Giant Race Leader’s soul emitted cries of agony.
"Roar! Roar! Let me go!"
To make a demigod-level creature emit such cries of anguish, one can imagine how terrifying the flames of the Demon Furnace are.
Once the sound subsided.
Thus, this Stone Giant Race Leader, who had lived for countless years, fell on the spot.
The Flame Plateau was also declared to have completely disappeared from the Holy Spirit Realm today.
Not only the Flame Plateau.
Each corner of the world saw the fleets of the Abyss Realm appear.
Those demons immediately began bombarding the various Sky Islands.
First, they killed all the creatures.
Then, through the [Demon Furnace], the souls of those creatures were refined into Soul Crystal Stones.
The wails of creatures from the Holy Spirit Realm continued endlessly.
In just half a day, the death toll reached an alarming number.
Many ancient beings made their moves, unleashing powerful auras that could be sensed even from tens of millions of kilometers away.
Yet there were even more terrifying Demon Gods whose auras suppressed these powers.
In the sky, blood-red nerve networks increasingly appeared, spanning the entire Holy Spirit Realm.
Then, under everyone’s gaze, they snapped!
On this day, the war between the Abyss Realm and the Holy Spirit Realm started in full swing.
Legends and demigods fell like rain.
Even signs of divine demise appeared several times.
The entire Holy Spirit Realm was covered by a rain of blood.
Those creatures, with wings and horns, piloting terrifying-looking warships, rampaged through the Holy Spirit Realm tyrannically.
Wherever they pass, all life ceases to exist.
Children close their eyes simultaneously, even infants cease their cries.
The creatures of the Abyss Realm left a deep, indelible impression of terror on everyone from the Holy Spirit Realm!
This day was recorded by the world as: Demon Descent Day!
At this moment, Han Xing and others remained in the teleportation state.

chapters.title: Chapter 1072 - 530: System Announcement Returns, The Path of War Begins! (Part 3)
paragraphs: Just at that moment, a system announcement appeared.
System Announcement: "Attention all survivors! The Abyss Realm has launched an all-out war, and the entire Holy Spirit Realm will be engulfed in the flames of war!"
"Those demons are incredibly powerful and exceedingly evil; they will kill all living things."
"This is a war against overwhelming odds, but you have no retreat!"
"Now, all survivors, please take up your weapons and participate in this battle for survival!"
Upon hearing this system prompt, the faces of Han Xing, Shen Yun, and the others all changed drastically!
"Radiance! Stop!"
The True God of Radiance swiftly exited the teleportation state.
He asked in confusion, "Master, what’s wrong?"
Han Xing and the others did not respond because their communication boxes were already overloaded!
A large number of survivors had sent them requests for help.
There were messages from Lanlan, Luo Chan, and Tangxin Mumu.
They informed Han Xing that a massive fleet of demons had appeared in the Witch Race Territory!
Wu Ling’Er was leading the Witch Race legion to fight fiercely against this group of demons.
Han Xing said solemnly, "Something’s gone wrong! The Abyss Realm is launching a full-scale attack!"
"These guys, I knew they were planning something big!"
Upon hearing this, the True God of Radiance looked bewildered, "A full-scale attack? So suddenly?"
Han Xing nodded, "It’s probably because the defeat of the four Ancient Demon Gods in the Void last time made them feel threatened."
"So these demons plan to take down the Holy Spirit Realm in the shortest time!"
In the future Han Xing saw, the full invasion of the Abyss Realm was not supposed to happen now.
Now, because he had changed the future, the developments of various things had already become unrecognizable.
The True God of Radiance also realized the seriousness of the situation.
"Master, what do you need me to do?"
Madeleine also walked over, "Dear Master, my power is at your disposal~"
Han Xing nodded, then asked, "Radiance, how long will it take to get to the Holy Spirit Realm from here."
Radiance quickly sensed for a moment and replied, "It will take about one more day.
Upon hearing this, Han Xing frowned and said, "I can’t wait that long. Is there any faster way?"
Radiance nodded, "Yes, I will now enter the fusion of the self state and will not exit it; within an hour, I can bring the Master to the Holy Spirit Realm."
"But by doing this, I will lose combat power due to consuming a large amount of divine power."
Han Xing pondered for a moment, then nodded, "Let’s do that for now, Radiance, take us forward at full speed!"
The True God of Radiance also nodded, then he took a deep breath.
The next moment, dozens of True God of Radiance appeared around and were all fused into his body!
The aura of the True God of Radiance was rapidly surging!
Then, he took a deep breath and said, "Fusion, the self!"
Buzz!
An overwhelming aura rose from his body.
The next moment, he directly covered the Sky Island with divine power and turned into a stream of light, rushing out.
They entered that peculiar spatial tunnel again, and the speed was even ten times faster than before.
What concept is this?
One must know that in normal teleportation states, they were already exceeding the speed of light by over ten times.
And now, it was completely surpassing the speed of light by hundreds of times!
The perspective of Han Xing and the others changed.
It was as if this time, they entered not a spatial tunnel but a time tunnel.
Everyone could clearly see past scenes of this Void, which Divine Spirit passed by here, or which small world once originated here.
Han Xing even saw Zhou Huang and the silhouette of that woman.
Just as they were hurrying at top speed, a second system prompt appeared.
[Attention all survivors!]
[Due to the overwhelming power gap between you and the Abyss Realm, the will of the Holy Spirit Realm will bestow upon you special blessings!]
[From now on, for every Abyss Realm monster you kill, you will receive a fivefold experience point boost, and killing a Tier Five demon will earn you a tenfold experience boost!]

[Furthermore, under the favor of the will of the Holy Spirit Realm, all your attributes will increase by 20%, and for each Legendary Level or above Abyss Realm monster killed, you will receive 1 colored Lock Metal Plate]
[The New Version of the Battle Merit Store is now reopening, with numerous blueprint rewards, potion rewards, and item rewards available.]
[All survivors, embark on your path of war!]
A series of system prompts, all encouraging survivors to bravely kill enemies!
Not only is there a fivefold to tenfold experience boost, but all survivors have also received a 20% attribute increase.
Besides this, the Battle Merit Store, colored Phantom Level material: Lock Metal Plate have all appeared!
One can imagine the system’s emphasis on this Abyss Realm invasion.
And it cannot be taken lightly!
Failure this time would mean the fall of the Holy Spirit Realm, and an all-GG end!
The survivors also heard the system prompt, and the chat channel exploded with a flood of messages.
At this moment.
In the Witch Race Territory.
A large number of Abyss Realm Teleportation Arrays were continuously opening.
Demon fleets covered the sky, appearing in every corner of the Witch Race Territory.
They started bombarding, destroying Witch Race Sky Islands one by one.
All the commanders of the Witch Race were concentrating all their attention, directing the battle.

chapters.title: Chapter 1073: The Determination of the Survivors
paragraphs: The demons opened their blood-red mouths and sneered, “Hahaha! This time, I’ve killed so many people, listening to those poor Witch Race soldiers being crushed bit by bit by me, I’m almost ecstatic!”

Beside them, another Legendary Level demon laughed and said, “Me too, and that group of humans, their soul strength is quite high, only need to refine the souls of a dozen humans to make one Undead Crystal!”
“In this way, I only need to kill hundreds of thousands of humans to break through to become a Demigod on the spot and become the new Great Demon Monarch, hahahahaha!”
At the same time, the commander in this legion, a high-tier Legendary demon, waved his large hand.
“Bomb! Keep bombing!”
“First weaken the defenses of these legions, then send out the Death Knight army to completely destroy their defenses!”
Boom! Boom!
The Skeleton Catapult kept bombing, as did the Hellfire Missile Silo, Flesh-Separating Cannon!
This terrifying Abyss Realm technology took away the lives of countless creatures.
And at this moment, Wu Ling’Er sent a message.
“All Witch Race legions, listen to the order!”
“Preserve your power, do not entangle with these demons, retreat to the Witch Race Main City, and conduct the final defensive battle!”
Upon hearing Wu Ling’Er’s order, various army commanders swiftly issued various commands.
Retreat! Return to Witch Race Main City!
And as the Witch Race army withdrew.
The demon fleet seemed unstoppable!
Flattening countless Sky Islands along the way, including many resource Sky Islands.
But for Wu Ling’Er, these resource Sky Islands are secondary, the most important is to preserve all power.
As large numbers of legions retreated to the Witch Race Main City region.
Here, there are hundreds of billions of people from the Witch Race and tens of billions of human survivors left.
They all knew this would be the final battle.
Meanwhile.
The Abyss Realm monsters, after destroying numerous Sky Islands in the Witch Race territory, all gathered near the Main City.
Looking at those evil figures covering the sky, everyone prepared for battle.
At this moment, Wu Ling’Er directly opened the full-territory broadcast: “Everyone, the moment of life and death has arrived!”
“Whether we survive or perish, it depends on today’s battle!”
“We, the Witch Race, have experienced this situation many times; I believe that no Witch Race person will fear this scene!”
“Let us, as before, kill all our enemies!”
Upon hearing Wu Ling’Er’s voice, all Witch Race soldiers shouted loudly.
“Kill!”
“Kill!”
“Kill!”
As Wu Ling’Er said, before this, they had constantly battled with the Shadow Legion.
There were even several times when they nearly faced extermination.
Therefore, this kind of situation is already commonplace for them.
However, the survivors from Blue Star had worried looks on their faces.
Because they have system panels that allow them to see the strength and level of these monsters, feeling immense despair.
Jinji the Kip: “Damn, there are so many Abyssal Monsters, none below level 40, how the hell do we fight this?”
Shenchi Yisha: “Yeah, I’ve also seen quite a few Tier Five Dominator, Legendary Level demons among them.”
“Any Legendary Demon can crush us to death directly.”
Compared to the imposing Witch Race army, the survivors have not undergone rigorous training and appear scattered.
And seeing so many powerful creatures from the Abyss Realm, a sense of helplessness arises in their hearts.
Hei Xu: “By the way, where did the Star God go? The Star God and all have broken through to Demigod, dealing with these Abyssal Monsters should be easy, right?”
Spring and Autumn: “Yes, if the Star God doesn’t come back, we can’t win. It won’t be long before we’re all killed by these demons.”
Thirteen Cheng: “Star God, where are you? Come back quickly!”
The survivors kept calling Han Xing’s name in the chat channel.
However, at this time, Han Xing is still frantically rushing.
Sensing the decline in the survivors’ morale.
At this moment, Luo Chan stepped forward.
She is now an important member of Xingyu City, faintly representing Han Xing.
Before Han Xing returns, these survivors
Luo Chan, dressed in green, standing on the deck of a Witch Race Battleship, looked absolutely stunning.
Instantly, she attracted the attention of countless people.
But her expression was very serious.
Luo Chan directly said in the chat channel in a deep voice: “Everyone, I know you’re waiting for the Star God and believe without the Star God, we can’t be a match for these demons.”
“But all this time, we’ve depended too much on the Star God.”
“In times of crisis, we just wait for the Star God to save us.”
“Even we’ve forgotten how to save ourselves.”
Hearing this, tens of billions of survivors remained silent.
Because what Luo Chan said is indeed true.
Over the years, several life-threatening crises for humans were resolved by Han Xing.
They even don’t know if without Han Xing, humanity would have already been extinct.
At this time, one survivor said, “Luo Chan Goddess, we know we can’t always rely on the Star God, but...”
“But this time the enemy is too strong... with our current strength, there’s no chance of winning...”
Other survivors echoed: “Yes, Luo Chan Goddess, the gap between us and these monsters is too great, we’ll be crushed to death easily.”
Listening to this, Luo Chan immediately said: “It’s precisely because the gap is large that we need to work harder to become stronger.”
“Think about the Star God; he started with the same conditions as us, yet has already reached level 60 and broken through to Demigod!”

chapters.title: Chapter 1074 - 531: The Survivors’ Resolve! (Part 2)
paragraphs: "Since he can do it, I think as fellow Survivors from the Blue Star, we all should be able to do it!"
"Don’t say that the Star God is a special case."
At this point, Luo Chan paused and then continued, "Now, there’s an opportunity before us, an opportunity for all of us to quickly become stronger!"
"Killing these Abyssal Monsters will give five times the Experience, even ten times!"
"As long as we kill enough enemies, we can even directly break through to Level 50."
"Then, the Star God will help us break through to the Legendary Realm!"
"Do you want to have the power to destroy a city with a wave of your hand? Do you want to be respectfully called a Legend?"
"Then go and kill the enemy!"
At this moment, the Survivors were already swayed by Luo Chan’s words.
Some of the Survivors said in the chat channel: "Come on! What’s the big deal, it’s just death!"
"Damn it, it’s been five years since I came to this hellish world, and I thought I would die five years ago, am I still afraid of these Demons?"
Other Survivors echoed: "That’s right! Let’s take down these Demons!"
"I’m going to break through Tier Five, I want to become a Legend!"
"And me! Don’t fight me for the spot to break through to Legend!"
At this time, a Survivor named Mammoth said: "Luo Chan Goddess, we are not afraid of these damned Demons, can you ask the Star God for more slots, ten slots are not enough?"
Upon hearing this, the other Survivors immediately echoed: "Yes, Luo Chan Goddess, we also want to break through to Legend!"
Luo Chan’s lips curled into a smile, and then she softly said: "Alright, I will convey your requests to the Star God."
"Now, prepare for battle!"
As soon as the words fell!
The Demon fleet had arrived!
That frenzied group of Demons looked at the massive Sky Island with delight in their eyes.
The leading Demigod-level Great Demon Monarch exclaimed: "I can feel it! There are hundreds of billions of living beings on this Sky Island!
"And tens of billions of humans!"
"Such strong Power of the Soul! Fantastic! Fantastic!"
"If I can kill all these people and refine their souls into Soul Crystals, I might even break through to the Divine Realm!"
Upon hearing this, the eyes of the Abyssal Monsters behind this Demon also turned frenzied.
To them, even if they don’t get any Soul Crystals, the ability to devour the flesh of living beings is a very delightful thing.
It’s a rare delicacy.
And at this moment, a Legendary Demon nearby reported: "Lord Morris, there are also eight Legends on this Sky Island, one of which is a High-tier Legend with formidable combat power."

"Moreover, there are a lot of humans here. The Emperor specifically instructed us to be wary of a human named Han Xing. If we find his trace, we should immediately perform a ritual to summon the Ancient Demon God."
Upon hearing this, the Great Demon Monarch chuckled and said: "What are you talking about? Are a few Legendary-level ants worth our attention?"
"As for those humans, they are ants among ants, not even a single Tier Five powerhouse."
"If that kid named Han Xing is here, I will crush him with my hand!"
Upon hearing this, the Legendary Demon said no more.
The Great Demon Monarch patted his shoulder and then said: "Rest assured, our Demon Legion will trample everything underfoot."
"Now, charge with me!"
With these words.
A white Bone Horn suddenly sounded among the Abyss Legion behind them.
"Woooo——"
The loud horn sounded like a wail of the deceased.
At this moment, the battle ignited instantly!
Rumble!
A massive horde of Abyssal Monsters and those Legends attempted to rush into the Witch Race Continent.
And at this moment, a barrage of attacks from Energy Towers instantly appeared from the Witch Race Continent.
The Tower of Truth, Hellfire Missile Silo, Flamethrower Catapult, Skeleton Catapult, including the Spiritual Godslaying Cannon.
Bang! Boom!
Terrifying energy fluctuations instantly emerged.
The Abyssal Monsters looked like they had seen ghosts, seeing the Technology Weapons belonging to their Abyss Realm unleash various bombardments on them.
One Hellfire fell among the monster horde, producing a heavy explosion.
Bang! Bang, bang!
The Hellfire swung its fists, blasting the surrounding Abyssal Monsters into meat paste.
And the attacks from other Defense Towers turned a large number of Abyssal Monsters into fragments directly!
Even the Legendary Demons were forced back by the Spiritual Godslaying Cannon.
A Middle-tier Legendary Demon, with an incredulous expression, said: "What the hell, how did these people master our Abyss Realm’s technology?"
Another Legendary Demon angrily said: "Damn! Those energy beams have terrifying destructive power, I just tested touching it, and almost half of my body was blown away!"
Upon hearing this, other Legendary Demons also furrowed their brows.
They realized that they might have encountered a tough opponent this time!
And at this moment, the leading Great Demon Monarch snorted coldly: "This Sky Island’s firepower is indeed powerful, but do not panic."
"The stronger the Defense Tower, the longer the attack intervals."
"Now, continue the attack!"
Upon hearing the Great Demon Monarch’s command, a large number of Abyssal Monsters surged forward.
As it said, this time the Witch Race Sky Island’s firepower significantly weakened.
The attacks from the Spiritual Godslaying Cannon also ceased.
Without Han Xing’s Sun Crown Stele, the cooldown time of these High-Level Defense Towers is indeed too long.
And those Legendary Demons laughed heartily, "A bunch of ants, actually delusional enough to use these Defense Towers to hold back our Abyss Legion’s advance!"
"You just scared us really, but now it seems they were just for show."

At least twenty legendary-level demon auras burst forth, enveloping the entire Witch Race Sky Island.
The soldiers of the Witch Race and the survivor army were suppressed by this aura, their faces turning pale.
Seeing this scene, the Abyssal Monsters’ morale soared!
"Hahaha! Our Abyss Realm has so many legendary demons, we completely crush this bunch!"
"Charge forward, kill them all!"
They crazily rushed to the ground of the Sky Island, engaging in direct combat with the Witch Race army and the survivor army.
Those legendary demons were just about to rush forward and join the fight.
At that moment, a series of strong auras surged to the sky!
They were the various high priests of the Witch Race!
The aura on their bodies was far more formidable than that of these demons.
Like burning comets, they fiercely collided.
Boom!
Rumble!
The violent tremor made the entire sky constantly quake.
Not only that, these Witch Race priests also showcased formidable strength.
Each of them fought two, even three, directly holding off all these legendary demons, and faintly showed a trend of suppression.
Seeing this scene, the Witch Race soldiers, with their hearts cleared of concealment, loudly mocked.

"In a one-on-one state, our priests can easily take down your legendary demons!"

All along, the powerhouses of the Abyss Realm were too dominant.
Even they themselves believed demons were the strongest at the same tier.

The reason these Witch Race priests were so strong was because of the Fortune Value bonus from Han Xing’s camp, otherwise, they couldn’t display such powerful combat strength!

"Kill all these Abyssal Monsters! Drive them out of our Witch Race Territory!"
The shouts of killing shook the sky.
At this moment, the morale-boosted Witch Race army actually began to kill the Abyss Legion in reverse.

"Brothers, wait for me! Add me in for the boss fight!"
"Damn, which fer just stole my monster, I’ll fing kill you!"
"Don’t fing steal it, that Abyssal Demon Eye is the one I targeted, damn it!"

Five times, ten times the Experience Value, plus the rich rewards from the Battle Merit Store, and the Legendary slot promised by Han Xing, the survivors risked their lives!

Or launched remote attacks, or wielded hot weapons to fight.
Even if large numbers of Abyssal Monarchs kept landing on the Sky Island,
Tens of billions of survivors, cooperating with tens of billions of the Witch Race army, combined with the many Defense Towers left by Han Xing, the situation unexpectedly became a stalemate.

"It’s actually just a legend?"

Compared to Cao Xing and the others, these natives’ speed of strength increase is really too slow.

But quickly, it regained its composure.
"Humph! What if you block my attack!"
"Die for me!"
As the words fell, the Great Demon Monarch charged directly.
Wu Ling’Er frowned lightly, her figure instantly vanished from the spot, engaging in fierce battle with this group of demigod-level demons!

paragraphs: Wu Ling’Er engaged in a fierce battle with the demigod level demon!
After a few minutes, Wu Ling’Er coughed up blood and retreated in defeat!
Seeing this scene, a sinister smile appeared at the corner of the Great Demon Monarch’s mouth.
"As expected, although you possess strength that can contend with a demigod, in the end, you’re just a legend."
"The gap between us is too vast."
"Moreover, by burning your divine power like this, the powerful combat strength you gain won’t last long."
"By then, I won’t even need to make a move; you’ll explode on your own!"
Hearing these words, Wu Ling’Er’s expression did not change at all.
However, she gritted her teeth and engaged the Great Demon Monarch in battle once more.
Forty minutes later.
The abyssal army’s prolonged attack was unsuccessful.
Moreover, the abyssal army suffered significant casualties.
Although the Witch Race also had casualties, the ratio of loss was still heavier on the Abyss Legion’s side.
Even the Great Demon Monarch probably hadn’t expected that the power on this Sky Island could hold out for so long.
The Great Demon Monarch, who was battling Wu Ling’Er, gradually grew agitated.
With a single blow, it cleaved Wu Ling’Er apart.
Then it pointed to several demons fighting with the Witch Clan Priests nearby and ordered.
"Go, the Emperor’s will is calling you, use your blood to open a new teleportation array!"
"Let these fools know, we of the Abyss Realm do not fear madness!"
Upon hearing this, the legendary demons all had sinister grins appear in their eyes.
Then, under the astonished gaze of the Witch Clan Priests, the legendary demons self-destructed on the spot!
Splatter! Splatter splatter splatter!
Blossoms of blood soared, and a vast blood mist spread!
At the same time, two hexagram teleportation arrays appeared once more.
Then, two terrifying auras shot into the sky!
"It’s been four thousand years, I, Cancirias, have returned to the Holy Spirit Realm, this time, I will devour everything!"
A terrifying Great Demon Monarch with horns, possessing middle-tier demigod strength, appeared.
Beside it, a demon with a dark aura holding a scythe stood silently.
Though it said nothing, no one dared ignore its presence.
Because this demon also possessed demigod level combat strength!
As soon as the two Great Demon Monarchs emerged, they surveyed the battlefield, quickly grasping the situation.
In the next moment, they split up to act.
One Great Demon Monarch rushed towards the nearby Witch Race Legion that was fighting.
The other demon appeared behind Wu Ling’Er.
Meanwhile, the demon scythe in its hand silently moved towards her neck.
At that moment, Wu Ling’Er seemed to envision her beautiful head being severed.
In the critical moment, Wu Ling’Er resorted to the Witch Clan Forbidden Technique.
Forcibly leaving her location!
However, even though she left the battlefield, a line of blood appeared on Wu Ling’Er’s neck.
"Splurt!"
A jet of blood erupted from Wu Ling’Er’s neck, rapidly staining her garments crimson.
The scythe demon remarked with interest: "Oh? Interesting, a legend managed to evade my attack."
Next to him, the Great Sword Demon warned: "Be cautious, this woman is not simple; she possesses demigod level strength."
Hearing this, the scythe demon’s interest deepened.
Then, the two demigod level demons began a simultaneous assault on Wu Ling’Er.
Meanwhile.
With the third Great Demon Monarch joining the fray, the situation swiftly deteriorated to a one-sided disadvantage.
With one slash of the demon’s axe, a chasm of magma tens of thousands of meters long appeared on the ground.
Tens of thousands of the Witch Race’s army perished under that one axe.
The Witch Race commanders were horrified!
Just as that demigod demon prepared to deliver a second axe swing.
A Witch Clan Priest rushed out, attempting to block the strike.
However, the demigod demon seemed to have already noticed the legendary priest on the side.
A sinister smile appeared at its mouth corner, and the giant axe came down furiously.
"Splurt!"
A body was cleaved in half instantly!
The Witch Race was left with only ten legendary priests originally.
And today, another had fallen.
Moreover, the demon consumed the body of this Witch Clan Priest on the spot.
This scene left everyone on the battlefield with eyes wide open in fury!
A surge of rage filled their hearts.
All the Witch Race soldiers roared: "Kill! Slaughter them all!"
"Exterminate these Abyssal Realm scum!"
Yet, their resistance was futile against demigod level power.
With the demigod demon’s axe descending again.
Splurt! Splurt splurt!
The Witch Race army and human race survivors died in droves.
Their souls were absorbed by the demons’ forge.
At this moment, a sense of powerlessness surged within everyone’s hearts.
Moreover, from the teleportation array, more abyssal monsters continued to emerge.
And over at Wu Ling’Er’s side, under the siege of the two Great Demon Monarchs, she increasingly found it hard to hold on.
The situation was on the brink of a total collapse!
Meanwhile, the two Great Demon Monarchs combined forces and had already driven Wu Ling’Er to a critically injured state.
They sealed off Wu Ling’Er’s escape routes from both the front and the back.
The murmurs of demons echoed in Wu Ling’Er’s ears.
"Weaklings of the Holy Spirit Realm, do you feel it? How insignificant you are?"
"Your so-called persistence is worthless in our eyes, and the weak should be devoured by us. Flesh turned into nourishment, souls refined into crystals!"
At this point, the scythe demon chuckled lightly: "Morris, I’ve taken a liking to this woman."
Hearing this, the Great Sword Demon remarked with keen interest: "Oh, what do you plan to do?"

chapters.title: Chapter 1077 - 532: Han Xing Returns, Overwhelming Slaughter! (Part 2)
paragraphs: The Scythe Demon replied, "I want to turn her into my collection, then hold her beautiful head every day and admire it."
"Ah, I can’t wait to kiss her lips right now!"
At this moment, Wu Ling’Er snorted coldly, "I am the Saint Master’s woman. Someone like you isn’t even worthy of lifting his shoes, yet you dream of touching his woman!"
The Scythe Demon chuckled lightly, "Oh? Who is your Saint Master? You speak of him so highly, yet even as you’re about to be beheaded by me, he hasn’t appeared?"
Wu Ling’Er remained silent, then gritted her teeth and said, "He will be back soon!"
"When my Saint Master returns, he will kill you all!"
Saying this, Wu Ling’Er turned and shouted, "Witch Race’s soldiers, do not be afraid!"
"Remember, we still have the invincible Saint Master Han Xing!"
"Once he returns, these beings from the Abyss Realm are nothing to be feared!"
"Use your weapons to tear these demons’ flesh apart; even in death, take the enemy with you."
"The Saint Master will avenge us!"
Upon hearing these words, morale, which had already been low, surged instantly!
"Roar!!!"
"The radiance of the Saint Master shines upon us!"
"Slaughter these scum from the Abyss Realm!"
"Saint Master Han Xing, we believe in you!"
This Witch Race army that had been forced to retreat was suddenly bursting with terrifying power!
They shouted Han Xing’s name while frantically attacking the demons!
Even the three Demigod Level demons showed an expression of surprise in their eyes.
This level of cohesion they had only ever seen from the Emperor of the Abyss Realm.
Merely shouting the Emperor’s name made all living beings from the Abyss Realm invincible!
And now, they were seeing it from this group of beings from the Holy Spirit Realm!
The Scythe Demon didn’t want to admit it, and sinisterly said, "What Saint Master Han Xing? Once I kill all the living beings on this Sky Island, I’ll imprint your soul.
"Then, you will obediently kneel down and serve me!"
As he finished speaking, the Scythe Demon suddenly pointed with one finger, releasing a burst of red energy.
The next moment, Wu Ling’Er felt her whole body stiffen, and uncontrollably moved towards the Scythe Demon.
Looking at the demon’s ugly body and crazed gaze, Wu Ling’Er gritted her teeth, "Even in death, I won’t let you defile my body!"
"My body belongs only to Saint Master Han Xing!"
The next moment, the blue energy on Wu Ling’Er’s body began to surge violently.
She was about to self-destruct on the spot!
The Scythe Demon chuckled lightly, "Foolish woman, to think you can do that in front of me, that’s not possible!"
"Freeze!"
A terrifying red energy enveloped Wu Ling’Er, instantly stopping her self-destruct attempt.
The Scythe Demon hooked its finger, and Wu Ling’Er flew towards it once more.
As the Scythe Demon’s expression drew closer, Wu Ling’Er could even see its blood-red eyes and drool at the corner of its mouth.
The Scythe Demon sneered, "Interesting woman, you will soon belong to me!"
"In my hands, you will experience ecstasy every day. I guarantee that in just a few days, you will willingly submit to me, hahahaha!"
At this moment, for the first time, panic appeared in Wu Ling’Er’s eyes.
She couldn’t help but cry out in despair, "Brother Xing..."
Right at that moment.
In the distant sky, a shooting star suddenly appeared.
Just a second ago, it was several hundred thousand kilometers away.
But the next second, it had appeared just tens of thousands of kilometers away.
The two Demigod Level demons instinctively felt something was off about this shooting star, immediately halting their actions, their hearts filled with caution.
They watched the direction of the shooting star, vaguely seeing a Sky Island.
And on the Sky Island stood a group of human silhouettes.
"Morris, something doesn’t seem right, let’s retreat first!"
The Scythe Demon’s eyes darkened.
As Demigod Level Demon Monarchs, their sense of danger was very keen.
The Great Sword Demon beside it also sensed something was off and nodded, "Alright, let’s move quickly!"
However, just as they were about to move, they suddenly felt the surrounding space become incredibly viscous.
With their strength, they could hardly move.
The next moment, the Sky Island had already reached them.
On the entire Witch Race battlefield, hundreds of billions of eyes simultaneously looked up.
They saw a human figure with a longbow on his back, wearing a black starlight battle armor, appearing in midair.
With a wave of his hand, the two demons were pinned to the spot.
Not only that, with this man’s gesture, the entire Witch Race Main City, no, the entire Witch Race Territory was brought to a standstill!
Whether it was the boundless Demon Monarchs, fleets, or the surviving fighters and Witch Race soldiers in battle.
All were frozen in place.
Meanwhile, the light on the Sky Island gradually dimmed.
Everyone saw several silhouettes standing there.
It was Han Xing!
At this moment, Wu Ling’Er, Luo Chan, global human survivors, including hundreds of billions of Witch Race people, all saw Han Xing’s figure.
At first, surprise appeared in their eyes, then it turned into disbelief.
And finally, it evolved into overwhelming joy!
However, because they were in a frozen state, they couldn’t speak at all.
With another wave of Han Xing’s hand, apart from the Abyss Legion, the control state of others was instantly lifted.

Right at that moment.
In the distant sky, a shooting star suddenly appeared.
Just a second ago, it was several hundred thousand kilometers away.
But the next second, it had appeared just tens of thousands of kilometers away.
The two Demigod Level demons instinctively felt something was off about this shooting star, immediately halting their actions, their hearts filled with caution.
They watched the direction of the shooting star, vaguely seeing a Sky Island.
And on the Sky Island stood a group of human silhouettes.
"Morris, something doesn’t seem right, let’s retreat first!"
The Scythe Demon’s eyes darkened.
As Demigod Level Demon Monarchs, their sense of danger was very keen.
The Great Sword Demon beside it also sensed something was off and nodded, "Alright, let’s move quickly!"
However, just as they were about to move, they suddenly felt the surrounding space become incredibly viscous.
With their strength, they could hardly move.
The next moment, the Sky Island had already reached them.
On the entire Witch Race battlefield, hundreds of billions of eyes simultaneously looked up.
They saw a human figure with a longbow on his back, wearing a black starlight battle armor, appearing in midair.
With a wave of his hand, the two demons were pinned to the spot.
Not only that, with this man’s gesture, the entire Witch Race Main City, no, the entire Witch Race Territory was brought to a standstill!
Whether it was the boundless Demon Monarchs, fleets, or the surviving fighters and Witch Race soldiers in battle.
All were frozen in place.
Meanwhile, the light on the Sky Island gradually dimmed.
Everyone saw several silhouettes standing there.
It was Han Xing!
At this moment, Wu Ling’Er, Luo Chan, global human survivors, including hundreds of billions of Witch Race people, all saw Han Xing’s figure.
At first, surprise appeared in their eyes, then it turned into disbelief.
And finally, it evolved into overwhelming joy!
However, because they were in a frozen state, they couldn’t speak at all.
With another wave of Han Xing’s hand, apart from the Abyss Legion, the control state of others was instantly lifted.

chapters.title: Chapter 1078 - 532: Han Xing Returns, Dominates and Slaughters!
paragraphs: This scene sent a chill through the hearts of all the demons.
Such methods were beyond their wildest imagination!
In contrast, the Witch Race was overjoyed.
They shouted aloud, "Lord Saint Master!! Oh heavens! It’s Lord Saint Master!!"
"Lord Saint Master! You’ve finally returned!"
"Hahaha! I told you Lord Saint Master would surely come back; he will definitely save us!"
Those Witch Race people, even the battle-hardened Witch Race soldiers, couldn’t help but burst into tears.
After experiencing so much, they had long regarded Han Xing as their faith.
And this man, as always, stood up in the most critical moment!
Han Xing came to the side of Wu Ling’Er, looking at this woman, beautiful but stubborn, covered in scars.
Then, he immediately pulled her into his arms.
In the next moment, the stubbornness on Wu Ling’Er’s face vanished.
She seemed to have suddenly found her backbone, and tears burst forth instantly.
"Waaah... I thought I’d never see you again, Brother Han Xing..."
Han Xing wiped away her tears from the corners of her eyes, then his fingers lightly brushed over her neck.
With the release of his Divine Power, the wound on Wu Ling’Er’s neck instantly stopped bleeding.
Moreover, it quickly healed as if it had never been injured.
"You’ve gone through a lot, Ling’Er."
Han Xing already knew what had just happened; he also knew that Wu Ling’Er almost self-destructed.
Upon hearing this, Wu Ling’Er buried her head even deeper into Han Xing’s embrace.
At this moment, the two Great Demon Monarchs were frozen in place, realizing how terrifying this man’s power was!
Sealing the entire Abyss Legion with ease!
Even existence at the Demon God Level cannot accomplish this!
Though they were immobilized, they still did not give up struggling.
Great bursts of demonic qi erupted from within them.
Among them, the Scythe Demon said sinisterly, "You are the one the Lord Demon God instructed us to keep an eye on, Han Xing."
"Kid, let me tell you, our Demon God has targeted you, and it’s not just one."
"Be smart, release us quickly, and perhaps when the Lord Demon God descends, you’ll get to keep an intact corpse!"
Nonetheless, Han Xing merely glanced at them indifferently,
"Did I give you permission to speak?
In the next moment, with a single gesture of one hand, Han Xing slowly grasped with his right hand.
"Boom! Boom!"
Two blood flowers instantly exploded!
Until now, these Great Demon Monarchs, who represented invincibility, were easily crushed like bugs by Han Xing.
Not only that, these two demons’ souls were absorbed by the Demon Furnace.
Then, as the furnace’s flame ignited,
The souls of the two Great Demon Monarchs emitted screams that made one’s scalp tingle!
"It hurts! It hurts so much!"
The demon furnace’s flame was extremely harmful to souls, even Great Demon Monarchs of the demigod level couldn’t endure it!
However, after a few seconds, their cries completely ceased, transforming into two soul crystals.
Seeing this, not only the demons but also hundreds of billions of Witch Race people had a look of bewilderment in their eyes.
Survivors muttered in confusion, "Damn! Did I see that right just now?"
"The Star God casually crushed two demigod-level demons?"
"Isn’t it said he just broke through to a demigod? How is he suddenly so terrifying?"
The Witch Clan Priests were also deeply shocked.
"Oh heavens! What kind of mighty power is this!"
"Could it be that the Lord Saint Master has already broken through to the Divine Level?"
In the hearts of these Witch Race people, demigods were already the pinnacle power of the Holy Spirit Realm, with divine spirits appearing only in legends.
Yet now, their Lord Saint Master casually crushed two Great Demon Monarchs that nearly exterminated their race!
This had completely overturned their understanding!
At this moment, Luo Chan suddenly stepped forward and shouted, "The Star God is invincible! Lord Saint Master is invincible!"
In the next instant, everyone realized what was happening, and they simultaneously shouted.
"The Star God is invincible! Lord Saint Master is invincible!"
"The Star God is invincible! Lord Saint Master is invincible!!"
The shout of hundreds of billions shook the heavens and earth!
At this moment, even the frenzied demons felt the fervent faith within these people’s hearts.
This was a craze that was no less fervent than that for the Demon Emperor!
Han Xing released Wu Ling’Er from his embrace, then looked at the countless beings below him and nodded, saying, "Everyone, I have returned."
"Sorry for returning a bit late."
Upon hearing this, the Witch Race people were instantly moved to tears.
"No problem at all, Lord Saint Master, you returning is enough."
"That’s right! Lord Saint Master, we will always wait for you, even if fighting to the last person, we will always wait for your return!"
"Saint Master! I’ll follow you forever!"
Including those survivors, none of them blamed Han Xing in the slightest.
"Star God, you don’t need to apologize, we know you are doing very important things!"
"Indeed, indeed, I now understand how fast the Star God’s strength is growing, and behind this, there must have been a lot of effort."
"Star God, you’re so handsome!"
"So cool! Directly crushing two demigod demons! If I were this cool, I’d laugh myself awake in my dreams hahaha!"
"Star God! Look at me, look at me! I’m your ten-year-old fan, Vortex Potato!"
The survivors chattered incessantly.
At this moment, Shen Yun and Cheng Jianyong, along with everyone around Han Xing, all looked at him with gentle smiles.
For a moment, they also felt a sense of pride and honor.
The crowd completely ignored the fact that there were still many demons nearby.
Because they believed, as long as Han Xing was by their side, these demons couldn’t harm them.
Han Xing nodded slightly at this moment, "Thank you all for your understanding."
"Now, I’ll give you a choice."
"Should I directly get rid of this group of demons, or should I crush all these Legendary Demons and leave the Abyss Legion below for you?"
Upon hearing this, the soldiers of the Witch Race dared not answer.
But the survivors became excited!
They instantly understood Han Xing’s intention.
He wanted them to eliminate this group of abyssal monsters to earn a huge amount of experience!
You must know that there are at least tens of billions of abyssal monsters here, together with the current tenfold experience increase.
The amount of experience that could be gained was simply unimaginable!
