chapters.title: Chapter 1079 - 533: Displaying Strength
paragraphs: The survivors excitedly replied, "Star God! We choose the second option!"
"That’s right, Star God, we also want to quickly reach level 50 and then break through to Tier Five!"
At this moment, a survivor named Shu Jun said, "Star God, many of us want to break through to Legendary, but 10 slots is a bit too few, can you add a few more?"
Upon hearing this, others recalled something.
Han Xing had previously promised to help the first ten survivors who reached level 50 advance to Legendary.
For a moment, survivors exclaimed, "Yeah, Star God, can you add a few more slots? We also want to break through to Legendary!"
"Star God! Please add more!"
Seeing their enthusiasm.
Han Xing listened, smiled, and said, "Alright, as an exception, I’ll increase the number of Legendary slots to 100!"
"Next, the first hundred individuals who reach level 50 can come to me, and I will help you break through to Legendary."
To Han Xing, helping a hundred survivors break through to Legendary only consumes the Divine Power contained in 10 Divine Formats.
It seemed a bit of a loss, but Han Xing was willing.
And for those survivors, this was incredibly good news!
Below, the survivors instantly shouted, "Long live Star God!"
"Star God! I love you! Hahaha!"
"Star God, quickly break the seal on this Abyss Legion, I want them to know, in a one-on-one state, these guys are just worthless!"
Han Xing nodded and then glanced at the dozen or so Legendary Demons, as well as one Demigod level demon among them.
With a squeeze of his hand.
"Puff! Puff puff puff!"
Instantly, dozens of blood flowers burst forth.
The system prompts appeared.

[Successfully killed Abyss Demon: Morris, Middle-tier Legendary Level creature, gained 1.824 billion Experience points. During the event, Experience points * 10 times, gained 18.24 billion Experience points.]

[Successfully killed Abyss Demon: Gabriel, High-tier Legendary Level creature, gained 6.444 billion Experience points. During the event, Experience points * 10 times, gained 64.44 billion Experience points.]
[Successfully killed...]
More than a dozen system prompts appeared consecutively.
Including Cheng Jianyong and others, a white light appeared simultaneously on five people.
The Experience points from three Demigods, 17 Legendary Demons, brought a massive amount of Experience points to everyone.
Plus, with a tenfold Experience point bonus.
The entire group rose directly to level 61 in one wave.
Han Xing was pleased, this was truly an opportunity for leveling up!
This time, the Abyss invaded fully; the number of Abyssal Monsters was beyond comprehension!
And they had just all broken through so they could fully utilize this opportunity to charge straight to level 70 and then immediately break through to Divine Spirit.
After all, their next breakthrough hardly had any bottleneck.
From Demigod to Divine Spirit, they just needed to reach a certain Rule Mastery Level.
With the complete rules and Divine Formats Han Xing had on hand, he could push them all to High-tier Divine Spirits.
Thinking of this, Han Xing even considered taking out all the Abyssal Monsters here and enjoying the Experience by himself.
However, having already spoken up in front of so many people, he couldn’t retract his words.
"Ahem!"
He coughed twice and then gave Madeleine a look.
Madeleine smiled charmingly, and instantly lifted all Divine Power restrictions.
Indeed, with Han Xing’s Demigod level Power, he naturally couldn’t directly seal the entire Witch Race Territory.
Behind this was Madeleine’s True God level Power.
The next moment, the group of demons was released from control.
However, when they looked at the figure overhead, they didn’t dare make any moves.
But the group of survivors wouldn’t care about all that, one by one they crazily charged ahead, launching various attacks.
Groups of Abyssal Monsters fell at their feet.
In fact, Han Xing could have Madeleine control these demons to death,
However, Han Xing didn’t want these survivors to battle too easily.
Because ahead, they had many more enemies.
More Abyss Legions, Evil Gods in Alternate Space.
And the upcoming Era of Extinct Gods.
These are all unimaginably formidable foes.
Thus, Han Xing wanted these survivors to feel pressure while rapidly leveling up.
These Abyssal Monsters were the perfect opponents.
Indeed, the Abyssal Monsters were also a group of frenzied beings.
Upon seeing that Han Xing and others were only watching and not intervening.
They also started counterattacking, engaging in fierce battle with the survivors.
However, it was clear this was a meaningless struggle.
Because with Han Xing and the others present, the hundreds of billions of Abyssal Monsters here had no chance of escape.
So, they were basically a group of trapped beasts, eventually turning into Experience, falling at the feet of the survivors.
"Kill!"
"Take down those Abyss Realm scum!"
The cries of battle shook the heavens.
The entire battlefield plunged into a crazed state of slaughter.
Of course, the survivors weren’t without damages.
This was expected, after all, the Abyssal Monsters were powerful, and their numbers far exceeded those of the survivors.
But due to Han Xing and a group of Witch Race Legends overseeing, the survivors’ damages were minimized.
Moreover, Han Xing’s Demon Furnace continued to absorb the souls of those Abyssal Monsters.
Han Xing found that the soul strength of these Abyssal Monsters was equally formidable.
It only took souls from tens of thousands of Abyssal Monsters to refine a Soul Crystal.
And each Soul Crystal could enhance 1 point of Divine Power.
Hence, if they could wipe out all these hundreds of billions of Abyssal Monsters, Han Xing could at least harvest tens of thousands of Soul Crystals.

chapters.title: Chapter 1080: Demonstrating Strength (2)
paragraphs: Even the Power of Rules at the True God level can only increase by 200,000 Divine Power!

Han Xing’s heart suddenly surged with excitement, “Whoa, if I think about it, taking down hundreds of billions of Abyssal Monsters is equivalent to taking down a True God. This wave is definitely profitable!”
Thinking about this, Han Xing couldn’t help but feel a bit excited.
After all, this time the Abyss Realm was launching a full-scale invasion.
The number of Abyssal Monsters arriving in the Holy Spirit Realm is simply unimaginable.
Without needing to eliminate them all, just taking down a portion would guarantee Han Xing more than a million Divine Power Value in gains.
“Ha ha, with this, forget about a hundred Legends; I could mass-produce ten thousand Legends!”
Han Xing was overjoyed.
Seeing the situation stabilize below,
Han Xing quickly began to check his Communication Jade Pendant.
He discovered that crises were happening everywhere in the Holy Spirit Realm, outside of the Witch Race Territory.
Several races had even been exterminated.
Now, the most severe crisis was still within the Elf Realm.
There, the Abyss Realm had the most fleets.
According to the message sent by the Elf King, seven or eight beings of Demon God level had appeared among them.
They nearly had Ancient Demon Gods at the True God level emerge.
Compared to the Elf Realm, the Witch Race Territory only had a few Demigod level Demons appearing, which seemed minor.
Han Xing took a deep breath and said, “Madeleine, leave a seal here; we must hurry to the Elf Realm and can’t waste time here.”
Simultaneously, Han Xing directly applied the Infinite Domain to the remaining nine Witch Clan Priests and Wu Ling’Er.
They felt their auras instantly surge dramatically.
Middle-tier Legends rose to High-tier Legendary Level, and High-tier Legends to Top-tier Legendary Level.
Meanwhile, Wu Ling’Er, even without burning the Witch Clan Secret Pattern, attained Demigod level combat power!
Everyone’s eyes showed astonishment,
and the next moment, they realized this was Han Xing’s ability.
This group of Witch Clan Priests exclaimed, “The Lord Saint Master’s power is truly vast and unfathomable!”
“Incredible! How was that accomplished?”
Wu Ling’Er also looked at Han Xing with complete admiration.
Of course, they didn’t understand. After all, this was the effect of the [Infinite Domain].
Throughout the Void’s countless years, only he and that one unknown entity have achieved this.
The Infinite Domain is beyond everyone’s imagination; even Han Xing has only explored a portion of its abilities.

Han Xing looked at these Witch Clan Priests and then instructed, “Continue defending the Witch Race Territory. After this battle is over, lead all Survivors to the Beastman Kingdom, Endless Tree Sea, and liberate our ally territories.”
“After these two places are cleared, proceed to other areas of the Holy Spirit Realm.”
“I’m leaving two Mecha here; these two Mecha have the power to crush High-tier Divine Spirits.”
With those words, two Mecha, towering tens of thousands of meters high, emerged.
Yes, because Han Xing’s [Infinite Domain] is not distance-limited, it can provide a permanent boost.
Even if he took away the two Sun Crown Steles, the Lingxiao still retained the power of Top-tier Divine Spirits.
Upon hearing this, all the Witch Clan Priests simultaneously became solemn.
They were awestruck as they looked at these two Mecha, unable to imagine that these metal hulks could possess Divine level combat power.
In their impression, Divine Spirits were legendary creatures, invincible beings.
And now, Han Xing could casually produce Divine level combat capability.
They realized that this journey through the Void had seen Han Xing’s power grow so immensely, it was indeed a profound transformation!
All Witch Clan Priests respectfully agreed, “We follow your orders, Lord Saint Master!”
Han Xing nodded.
Then he turned to Madeleine, “Madeleine, take us there, target the Elf Realm!”
“Okay, my dear master~”
With those words, the Red Divine Power on Madeleine’s body unfurled.
Although she couldn’t use the True God of Radiance’s [Fusion of the Self] technique,
With Han Xing’s augmentation, Madeleine’s Movement Speed could also reach the level of a Middle-tier True God.
“Buzz!”
Everyone entered a space transition state.
Han Xing and his team arrived quickly and departed quickly, acting swiftly and decisively.
Below, everyone watched Han Xing’s departing figure.
The Human Race Survivors shouted, “Brothers, attack quickly!”
“Charge! I’m already level 47; in just a few minutes, I gained a level, this is fantastic!”
“Haha! I’m already level 48; today I must secure one of those hundred spots.”
“Brothers, the Luo Chan Goddess and Dragon Abyss powerhouse are almost breaking through to level 50; they’re slaying swiftly!”
The Survivors were utterly intoxicated by the massive Experience points.

paragraphs: Since the defense tower kills do not yield experience, they must act personally to level up quickly.
Everyone nodded in agreement.
This would be their first battle after breaking through to demigod status!
Everyone revealed their true skills.
Cheng Jianyong’s figure flickered, and in the next moment, he directly charged into the abyssal monster horde, shouting, "Die for me!"
The Holy Artifact Battleaxe in his hand slashed horizontally.
In the next moment, a terrifying Tearing Law descended.
The fan-shaped area tens of thousands of kilometers in front was covered in one strike.
Then a series of explosive sounds erupted.
"Puff! Puff puff puff!"
"Boom! Boom boom boom!"
Those demons and Abyss Battleships were completely wiped out!
Witnessing this scene, all the abyssal monsters turned back simultaneously, seeing the five people charging towards them.
All at once, the eyes of tens of billions of abyssal monsters were filled with confusion.
"What are those things?"
"I don’t know, it seems like a few humans."
"What terrifying attacks!"
Indeed, the strike that Cheng Jianyong just unleashed directly wiped out an entire Abyss Realm legion’s worth.
And at this moment, a Great Demon Monarch within the Abyss Legion also noticed Cheng Jianyong’s presence.
In an instant, three middle-tier demigod demons rushed towards him.
The abyssal monsters sneered: "Great Monarch Ollis and Great Monarch Miridi are heading over; they will be torn apart by the monarchs soon."
"We don’t need to bother with these guys, continue dealing with the Centaur Race!"
However, at this moment, Cheng Jianyong instantly locked on to the three middle-tier demigod Great Demon Monarchs.
His eyes turned cold.
"Ultimate Skill — Three Extremes Axe!"
Whish! Whish whish!
Exactly three attacks landed, and at this moment, the three Great Demon Monarchs only felt that they were firmly pinned in place by a terrifying power.
They couldn’t even utilize the Power of the Demon in their bodies, their hearts surging with shock!
"Damn it! How is this possible?"
"We are Great Demon Monarchs, and yet we are immobilized by a mere human’s aura!"
What they didn’t know was that Cheng Jianyong’s three axes are capable of letting a Divine Spirit fall.
Against a few demigods, it’s simply overkill.
The next moment.
Cheng Jianyong’s axe descended.
The three Great Demon Monarchs couldn’t even manage a moment of resistance, being directly chopped into blood mist.
And together with the space behind them, tens of thousands of meters were cleaved, creating three space rifts!
Puff! Puff puff puff!
A large number of abyssal monsters were swept up and annihilated by the aftershocks of this strike.
The blood stained the whole sky red.
Meanwhile, Han Xing and others were flooded with millions of kill notifications.

[Successfully killed Great Demon Monarch: Ollis, Initial-tier Demigod-level creature, gained 11.234 billion experience points, during the event, experience points are multiplied by 10, gained 112.34 billion experience points.]

[Successfully killed Great Demon Monarch: Miridi, Middle-tier Demigod-level creature, gained 31.944 billion experience points, during the event, experience points are multiplied by 10, gained 319.44 billion experience points.]
[Successfully killed...]
At this moment, the entire battlefield fell into a stagnant state.
The demons watched this scene in shock.
"By the Emperor! What happened?"
"Great Monarch Ollis and Great Monarch Miridi were insta-killed!"
"Damn it, what level is this human’s strength, could he be a legendary Divine Spirit?"
What these demons said was indeed correct, under the state of [Infinite Domain], Cheng Jianyong indeed possessed Divine Spirit-level strength.
What shocked these demons even more was yet to come.
As a beautiful woman with a devilish figure appeared.
She slowly raised her magic staff, softly chanting, "Ultimate Skill! Burning Prison Flame!"
Boundless Divine Power surged.
It seemed as if the entire sky’s focus gathered on that woman.
In the next moment, within an area of hundreds of thousands of kilometers, at least tens of millions of demons were suddenly engulfed by a terrifying flame.
They seemed to fall into a horrific Flame World in an instant,
as if these flames would burn the entire world to ashes!
Rumble!
The flames swept across.
Tens of millions of demons didn’t even have time to scream before being turned to ash.
At the same time.
When tens of millions of kill notifications appeared.
White light rose from Han Xing and the others once more.
They all leveled up to level 62.
This is the terror of the Supreme Magic Profession.
With a wave of the hand, able to take away tens of millions of lives, in terms of destructive power, Zhang Lianmeng is the strongest among them.
At this moment, not only did the eyes of the centaurs show bewilderment, but even the entire Abyss Legion was bewildered.
They seemed to realize something, exclaiming: "Another Divine Level existence!"
"Damn! Weren’t there supposed to be very few Divine Level existences in the Holy Spirit Realm? How did we run into two all at once?"
However, it was not over yet.
Shen Yun watched Cheng Jianyong slay on all fronts, and charged forward, saying: "Damn, let me show my ultimate skill too."
"Ultimate Skill! Light of Order!"
As he raised the Holy Hammer.
In the next moment, it was as if the sky was filled with divine light,
The coverage of these divine lights was only slightly smaller than Zhang Lianmeng’s Burning Prison Flame.
Not only that, but the entire battlefield, all abyssal monsters fell into a state of blindness.
Then, tens of millions of abyssal monsters were directly vaporized by Shen Yun’s move.
At the same time, Su Xiaoyang also unleashed the ultimate skill — Winter’s Extinction!
In an instant, terrifying low temperatures descended.
The temperature dropped directly to over a hundred degrees below zero, completely freezing the bodies of these abyssal monsters.
Crack! Crack!
After a series of sounds like ice sculptures breaking.
Su Xiaoyang’s move also took tens of millions of abyssal monster lives.
The number of souls absorbed in the Demon Furnace had reached a terrifying number.
The abyssal army in this area had already been wiped out by them!
The centaurs, with bewildered expressions, watched this scene, as if they had seen a ghost!
"By the Chief! What did I see?"
"A group of humans saved us!"
"Oh my God, they possess Divine Level power!"
This part of the battlefield was cleared by them within a few seconds.
Yet the centaur domain was vast, and there were other areas with abyssal armies.
Han Xing said, "Swift victory, we must move on to the next place."

chapters.title: Chapter 1082: The Harpy Tribe Submits
paragraphs: Everyone nodded simultaneously, then simultaneously displayed a speed far beyond Divine Spirit Level, flashing across the entire territory of the Centaur Race.
Upon seeing the Abyssal Army, various attacks fell.
With a casual strike, at least hundreds of thousands or millions of Abyssal Monsters were obliterated.
Then, the souls of those demons were equally absorbed by the Demon Furnace.
At this moment, Han Xing directly entered the Instant Prison Shadow Kill state.
It’s a terrifying Divine Skill.
Moreover, it can inherit the effects of the Endless Arrow Prison.
In other words, Han Xing can stay indefinitely in the [Instant Prison Shadow Kill] state.
“Kill!”
Boom! Boom!
Each arrow of Han Xing now exploded like nuclear bombs, sweeping over hundreds of kilometers!
Coupled with his terrifying speed, he completely transformed into the legendary Nuclear Bomb Sword Immortal.
Wherever he passed, everything was leveled.
The group of Abyssal Monsters finally realized it wasn’t just one Divine Level combat power but five!
With them, it wouldn’t take long to slaughter this Abyss Legion!
“Escape! Hurry and flee!”
“Quickly notify Lord Demon God, there are five Human Race gods here!”
Instantly, all Abyssal Monsters began to flee frantically.
The demons are brutal, fearless of death.
But dying here wouldn’t mean anything!
However, with the Painful Empress, a True God, here, none of the Abyssal Monsters could escape.
And after Han Xing and others slaughtered for a while, they smoothly advanced to Level 63.
They wiped out at least seventy percent of this Abyss Legion’s monsters.
The remaining thirty percent were too scattered, killing them would waste time.
Therefore, Han Xing directly said, “Gather.”
In the next moment, all four returned to the Sky Island.
Han Xing glanced at Madeleine, “Finish off the remaining monsters, let’s keep moving forward.”
Madeleine chuckled lightly, “As you command, Master~”
In the next moment, with a single hand gesture from her.
The remaining hundreds of millions of Abyssal Monsters on the battlefield exploded and died on the spot.
A massive number of souls surged into Han Xing’s Demon Furnace.
Not caring about the shocked Centaurs, Han Xing ordered, “Go!”
Buzz!
The Sky Island continued to traverse through the space tunnel.
Leaving behind the bewildered Centaur Race and countless corpses of Abyss Realm monsters...
The Sky Island pressed forward, whenever Han Xing saw traces of Abyss Legion, he’d have Madeleine stop.
Then, everyone would spend three to five minutes on a wave of slaughter.
At the same time, Han Xing kept in touch with the Elf King, inquiring about the situation in the Elf Realm.
Upon learning they could still barely manage, Han Xing gradually relaxed.
They continued the slaughter, as levels rocketed upward like a rocket.
In no time, the whole group advanced to Level 65!
Moreover, the quantity of Soul Crystal Stones refined in Han Xing’s Demon Furnace had surpassed three million!
What does that mean?
It equates to three million Divine Powers!
Nearly comparable to Han Xing’s plundering of over a dozen race treasuries in Silent City!
Han Xing showed a trace of joy in his eyes, “Good, good, good!”
“The Abyss Realm’s invasion, while a disaster, is also an opportunity for me.”
“As long as I kill enough monsters, I could quickly break through to ten million Divine Power, even twenty or thirty million might be possible!”
His current Divine Power Value is five million.
Han Xing vaguely senses.
After breaking through to ten million Divine Power, he would encounter some kind of wondrous transformation again.
Thinking of this, he became even more enthusiastic about killing these Abyssal Monsters!
At this moment, Madeleine led Han Xing and others, advancing for about twenty-five minutes.
The Elf Realm is about five minutes away.
That sounds close, but it’s actually several billion kilometers apart!
And soon, Han Xing and others discovered another race being overwhelmed by Abyssal Monsters.
This place was likewise filled with a massive Abyss Fleet.
A female with the lower half of an eagle and the upper half of a human soared mid-air, battling the Abyss Army to the death.
Their attire was extremely revealing, with the upper body mostly uncovered, only two feathers obscuring the chest’s crucial areas.
Each female’s features were stunning, perhaps among the Human Race, they are rare beauties.
This is the Harpies Race, a race of only females.
And the harpies of this race have already been mostly slaughtered by the Abyss Army!
The demons were extremely insane, their eyes gleaming with cruel smiles.
They grabbed the harpies’ two wings, then exerted force.
With a ripping sound.
One harpy’s wings were forcibly torn off!
A series of terrifying screams sounded, blood splattered high!
Not only that, their bodies were devoured on the spot by these Abyssal Monsters.
The souls were also absorbed and refined by the Demon Furnace!
Being utilized to the extreme.
Witnessing this, the Harpies Race Leader, Salonia’s eyes were filled with rage.
As one of the top ten beauties in the Holy Spirit Realm, known alongside Elf Race’s Divine Maiden, Elinora.
Her stunning features revealed an angry expression, with bluish-purple lips tightly clenched and her full chest heaving.
“Damn Abyssal Monsters!”
“I will tear you apart!”
At this moment, a demigod-level Great Demon Monarch suddenly appeared behind her.
“You better worry about yourself!”
With that, the Great Demon Monarch slashed down with a blade!
In a critical moment, Salonia barely shifted half a position, letting one wing bear the brunt of the Great Demon Monarch’s slash.
“Pff!”
Blood splattered high in the sky.
Salonia’s half-wing was severed.
